This position can be remote in the United States. **Summary** We are seeking a talented Radar Perception Engineer to join our team to develop and optimize the Radar Perception stack. You will play a critical role in enabling robust autonomy for our engineering machines, focusing on radar perception and data fusion with camera\-based perception systems to advance our autonomous agricultural technology capabilities. You will work across the full stack, from hardware integration to algorithm development and validation. * **Employment Type**: Full\-Time * **Work Location**: Remote in the United States * **Visa sponsorship**: Available for this position. **Job Responsibilities** A combination, not necessarily all\-inclusive, of the following: * Software Development \& Coding + Design and write robust, production\-quality C\+\+ code for real\-time radar perception algorithms and robotics pipelines. + Apply modern software engineering best practices to maintain reusable, testable, and high\-performance autonomy codebases. * Architecture \& Integration + Architect and support scalable radar fusion pipelines for autonomous systems. + Lead the development and integration of radar data products within broader autonomy perception stacks. + Drive cross\-functional collaboration to enhance sensor fusion performance and system reliability. * Algorithm Development + Develop and refine point cloud processing methods, including tracking and object classification and identification algorithms. + Implement odometric solutions and data fusion points for INS. * Validation \& Metrics + Lead verification and validation efforts for radar perception systems through comprehensive field testing. + Drive system performance optimization and regression testing to ensure robust perception capabilities. + Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to validate system safety and performance against rigorous field operational requirements. * Safety \& Reliability + Develop strategies for safety\-critical edge case detection, ensuring the perception system maintains robust performance in diverse agricultural environments. + Maintain high\-quality technical documentation for perception architectures, test results, and deployment guidelines to ensure code maintainability across the team. + Proactively profile system bottlenecks (CPU/memory/latency) and implement optimizations to ensure perception pipelines meet real\-time constraints on deployed robotic platforms. **Required Experience and Skills** * BS/MS in Robotics, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. * 3\+ years of professional experience in perception system development, with a strong focus on radar, robotics, and embedded systems. * Strong proficiency in C\+\+ and Python, with the ability to write similar). * Proficiency with middleware like ROS or ROS2, and familiarity with Linux/POSIX development environments. * Familiarity with point cloud processing, sensor fusion, and coordinate system transformations, including object identification, classification, and tracking. * Ability to work in a collaborative, cross\-functional environment (e.g., interacting with hardware, perception, and autonomy teams). **Preferred Experience and Skills** * Experience working with autonomous agricultural machinery, construction equipment, autonomous vehicles, or off\-highway robotics platforms. * Experience with radar\-camera sensor fusion, including sensor calibration, time synchronization, and multi\-sensor data integration. * Experience with radar\-camera sensor fusion, including sensor calibration, time synchronization, and multi\-sensor data integration. * Familiarity with safety\-critical perception systems, edge\-case analysis, and robustness testing under challenging environmental conditions. jobs.title: Program Manager, Data Science Core & GenAI Studio
jobs.description: **College Board \- Technology \- Data Science Core \& GenAI Studio** **Location:** This is a fully remote role. Candidates who live near CB offices have the option of being fully remote or hybrid (Tuesday and Wednesday in office). **Type:** This is a full\-time position **About the Team** The Data Science team develops analytical approaches, statistical models, and machine learning capabilities that help College Board make better decisions and deliver stronger outcomes for students and educators. Our growing team partners across research, product, engineering, business intelligence, and operations to turn complex questions and data into useful, responsible, and scalable solutions. This role supports both Data Science Core and Gen AI Studio teams. The work spans exploratory analysis, experimentation, model development, production delivery, and ongoing monitoring. Accuracy, transparency, privacy, and responsible use of data are essential, particularly in high\-stakes education contexts. What makes this team distinctive is its combination of rigorous data science, practical problem\-solving, and sustained cross\-functional collaboration. **About the Opportunity** As Program Manager, Data Science, you will create the structure and operating discipline that enables a growing data science portfolio to deliver meaningful results. You will connect strategy to execution by managing roadmaps, priorities, dependencies, risks, decision points, and communication across multiple workstreams. A core part of this work is making sure projects are ready before Data Science delivery begins: prerequisites confirmed, dependencies explicit, and decisions made on time. You will partner closely with data scientists, data and software engineers, product managers, researchers, and business leaders. You will help teams translate ambiguous goals into executable plans, maintain momentum through changing conditions, and make tradeoffs visible. You are not expected to serve as the lead data scientist; you will bring enough technical fluency to understand the data science lifecycle, ask sharp questions, and help specialists do their best work. Success in this role will be measured by the team's ability to focus on the highest\-value work, deliver reliable outcomes predictably, manage risk early, and build trust with partners. **In this role you will** **Manage Delivery Risk and Program Operations (30%)** * Establish lightweight, consistent operating rhythms for planning, status, decision\-making, risk review, and retrospectives. * Drive alignment across data science, engineering, and product stakeholders, ensuring dependencies and decisions are communicated clearly and on time. * Identify delivery, data, model, compliance, and resourcing risks early; drive mitigation and escalate when timely decisions are needed. * Track program health and outcomes using meaningful measures rather than activity alone, and use evidence to improve plans and processes. Maintain clear program artifacts, including roadmaps, dependency maps, decision logs, risk registers, and executive\-ready updates. * **Orchestrate Cross Functional Execution (25%)** * Coordinate work across data science, research, product, engineering, analytics, privacy, legal, security, and business teams. * Build executable plans from ambiguous goals and align contributors on scope, responsibilities, milestones, dependencies, and acceptance criteria. * Facilitate decisions and resolve blockers without replacing the judgment of technical or domain experts. Manage handoffs from research and prototyping through production delivery, adoption, and operational ownership. * **Drive Program Strategy and Portfolio Planning (20%)** * Translate Data Science strategy and business priorities into a clear portfolio of programs, workstreams, milestones, and measurable outcomes. * Own integrated roadmaps and planning processes, translating research priorities into sequenced milestones and tracking progress from experimentation through deployment. * Lead intake and prioritization in partnership with Data Science leaders, balancing impact, effort, capacity, risk, and sequencing. * Establish readiness criteria so projects have confirmed prerequisites, including data access, legal and privacy review, a named business owner, and agreed success measures, before Data Science delivery begins. Define program success measures and establish clear ownership, decision rights, and escalation paths. * **Build Stakeholder Alignment and Adoption (15%)** * Serve as a trusted partner to technical and non\-technical leaders, creating shared understanding of objectives, constraints, tradeoffs, and progress. * Communicate complex data science work in clear language appropriate to the audience, including uncertainty, model limitations, and responsible\-use considerations. * Create feedback loops with users and stakeholders so that solutions address real needs and adoption is planned from the beginning. Prepare concise recommend tation, adoption, and measurement. * You are familiar with, or can quickly build working knowledge of the data science lifecycle, including data readiness, experimentation, model development and validation, deployment, monitoring, and iteration; hands\-on model development expertise is not required. * You can translate ambiguous goals into clear plans, milestones, ownership, dependencies, risks, and decisions without creating unnecessary process. * You use sound portfolio and prioritization practices to balance strategic value, near\-term commitments, team capacity, technical constraints, and risk, including in settings where impact is measured by mission and stakeholder outcomes rather than revenue. * You are skilled at identifying and managing cross\-team dependencies, surfacing issues early, and driving resolution across teams you do not directly manage. * You communicate clearly with executives, technical teams, researchers, and business partners and can explain technical tradeoffs, uncertainty, and data or model limitations in plain language. * You are familiar with data quality, privacy, governance, security, and responsible AI considerations and know when to bring the appropriate experts into a decision. * You use program management and collaboration tools effectively and can adapt agile, iterative, or stage\-gated practices to the needs of the work. You demonstrate strong judgment, curiosity, accountability, and a commitment to inclusive collaboration and continuous learning. * **All roles at College Board require:** * A passion for expanding educational and career opportunities and mission\-driven work * Curiosity and enthusiasm for emerging technologies, with a willingness to experiment with and adopt new AI\-driven solutions and comfort with learning and applying new digital tools independently and proactively. * Clear and concise communication skills, written and verbal * A learner's mindset and a commitment to growth: welcoming diverse perspectives, giving and receiving timely, respectful feedback, and continuously improving through iterative learning and user input. * A drive for impact and excellence: solving complex problems, making data\-informed decisions, prioritizing what matters most, and continuously improving through learning, user input, and external benchmarking. * A collaborative and empathetic approach: working across differences, fostering trust, and contributing to a culture of shared success * You can travel 3 to 5 times per year to New York City or Reston, Virginia. You are authorized to work in the United States. * **About Our Process** * Application review will begin immediately and will continue until the position is filled. This role is expected to accept applications for a minimum of 5 business days. While the hiring process may vary, it generally includes: resume and application submission, recruiter phone/video screen, hiring manager interview, performance exercise such as live coding, a panel interview, a conversation with leadership and reference checks. * **What We Offer** At College Board, we offer more than a paycheck: we provide a meaningful career, a supportive team, and a comprehensive package designed to help you thrive. We’re a self\-sustaining nonprofit that believes in fair and competitive compensation grounded in your qualifications, experience, impact, and the market. **A Thoughtful Approach to Compensation** * The hiring range for this role is $120–$170\. * Your exact salary will depend on your location, experience, and how your background compares to others in similar roles at the College Board. * We aim to make our best offer upfront, rooted in fairness, transparency, and market data. We adjust salaries by location to ensure fairness, no matter where you live. * You’ll have open, transparent conversations about compensation, benefits, and what it’s like to work at College Board throughout your hiring process. Check out our careers page for more. \#LI\-Remote \#LI\-TheAcorn

jobs.title: Community Manager
jobs.description: **About Us** ------------ We are customer\-obsessed to an unusual degree. When we had a major network outage, everyone, including recruiters, engineers, and marketers, got on the phone with customers. That’s not a policy. It’s just who we are. What keeps us going is what we hear from our Community. Families tell us they used to wake up every morning with a knot in their stomach. They don’t anymore. They tell us our product changed their relationship with their parents, from anxious and fearful to present and connected. It’s genuinely important work, and we don’t take it lightly. If that’s the kind of problem you want to spend the next few years on, one with real scale, real mission, real momentum, and a real Community of people behind it, we’d love to talk. **What we’re building** ----------------------- Aging in America is broken. Seniors are isolated. Their families are anxious in ways that go far beyond “I hope Mom’s alright.” There are 55 million Americans over 65 living at home. Most of them, and most of their families, are navigating this alone. Community Phone is fixing that. We built a phone so simple it works out of the box, wrapped it with AI\-powered check\-in calls, and built a family app that turns daily dread into peace of mind. It’s working. We’re well into 8\-figure subscription ARR pacing to 9\-figure, with 30,000\+ families trusting us with something that matters deeply. We are called *Community* Phone for a reason, and that Community is real, warm, and growing. We’re now looking for the person who turns that quiet loyalty into a movement. **What you’ll own** ------------------- Building a community is a central part of our brand. We keep our customers connected: to their families and to the people who love and support them. As our Community Manager, you own the network and energy of our Community. **Community Engagement** — launch and own the customer newsletter and other touchpoints that make people feel part of something, not just billed by a vendor. **Organic Social** — own our organic social presence. Participate in and mobilize Facebook and Reddit communities around caregiving and senior safety. Own our organic Facebook and Instagram presences. Be obsessed with engagement, shares, and network growth. Figure out the puzzle of engaging a customer base that isn’t native to platforms like TikTok or Snapchat. **Referrals** — turn word\-of\-mouth into a machine. Our customers already recommend us; you make recommending us easy, rewarding, and constant. Own referral programs end\-to\-end. **What we’re looking for** -------------------------- * 3–5 years in community, social, or content marketing, with real ownership of a channel or program — not just posting. * You are a relentless engine. You do a remarkable amount of work. You don’t get blocked. Your manager thinks, “Wow, how did they pull that off?” not “I wonder what they are up to.” * You have proven opinions about how communities grow. You aren’t just writing out newsletters and clicking send. You’re fixated on the nature of our social network. Who are these customers? What makes them fall in love with something? How can we make that viral? * Strong writer. You can turn our product into an emotional message that a 65\-year\-old’s daughter understands and wants to forward. * A real feel for how things spread among people who are *not* young and *not* on TikTok. You can explain why something travels inside a 50\+ or caregiver community. * Enough hands\-on design sense to make your own organic content look good without waiting on a designer. * Analytical. You set goals, watch the numbers, and cut what isn’t working. * Bonus: you’ve marketed to older adults, caregivers, or their families. **How we’ll know it’s working** ------------------------------- * More customers refer more friends, month over month. * Newsletter and organic engagement grow, and customers tell us they feel part of a Community. * Word\-of\-mouth becomes something we can see, not just something we hope for. * Our organic social following and share rate climb steadily. **Compensation and logistics** ------------------------------ * $85,000–$105,000 base, plus equity. 401(k) and health insurance included. * Remote\-first. About 80 people across 15 countries. 3–4 in\-person offsites per year at domestic or international locations. * Backed by Y Combinator, YC Continuity, SNR.vc, and other top\-tier investors.

jobs.title: Growth Marketing Manager
jobs.description: * **Community Phone** Community Phone is building the best phone for communities in America. We power your hair salon’s business line, your auto\-body shop’s texting and booking, your local government’s operations hotline, and even your mom’s phone\-on\-her\-computer. With over 20,000 customers today, we’re on a mission to become the Square of community communications. Our \~80\-person team spans 15 countries and is backed by Y Combinator Accelerator and its Continuity Fund. We’re customer\-obsessed: when a network outage hit, everyone—from recruiters to engineers—jumped on calls to help. If you thrive on impact and hustle, join us. ### **Your Mission** As our **Growth Marketing Manager**, you’ll own and operate our full\-stack marketing engine end\-to\-end. From paid acquisition to attribution modeling, you’ll run campaigns across Google Ads, Bing Ads, Meta Ads, and emerging channels—designing ICP\-focused audience strategies, adaptive bidding frameworks, and rapid A/B tests that drive revenue and LTV. You’ll also translate performance data into compelling insights and strategic recommendations for our executive team, ensuring tracking integrity, attribution accuracy, and alignment with product and revenue goals. ### **What You’ll Do** **Executive Communication \& Reporting** * **Translate Data into Strategy:** Present key metrics and campaign insights in clear, concise narratives that align with business objectives. Tailor your language to a non\-marketing, technical executive audience, focusing on how performance impacts product roadmap, customer experience, and revenue forecasts. * **Structured Cadence:** Deliver daily, weekly, and/or monthly dashboards highlighting trends, anomalies, attribution shifts, ROI analysis, and experiment outcomes. * **Visual Storytelling:** Use simple yet powerful visualizations—funnel diagrams, attribution flowcharts, cohort trend lines—to make complex data immediately understandable and actionable. * **Anticipate Technical Questions:** Come prepared with clear explanations on tagging frameworks, offline conversion integrations, data pipelines, and algorithmic bidding logic. * **Collaborative Dialogue:** Lead two\-way discussions with executive stakeholders, surfacing risks and opportunities while refining next steps with clear recommendations and ownership. **Full\-Stack Campaign Leadership** * **End\-to\-End Channel Ownership:** Own strategy and daily execution across Google Ads, Bing Ads, Meta Ads, and new acquisition channels, ensuring they hit ROI and revenue targets. * **Precision Audience Targeting:** Build high\-intent ICP segments using lookalikes, exclusions, and behavioral data to drive qualified leads and reduce wasted spend. * **Adaptive Bidding Frameworks:** Launch and manage bid strategies (manual CPC, tCPA, tROAS) that balance short\-term performance with long\-term LTV. * **Performance Analysis \& Rapid Iteration:** Monitor KPIs daily, diagnose anomalies (e.g., CPA spikes, quality score drops), and drive A/B testing across creative, landing pages, and offers. * **Cross\-Functional Alignment:** Collaborate with Product, Growth, and Engineering to align campaign timing with feature releases, promos, and seasonal pushes. **Tracking \& Attribution Mastery** * Audit and resolve tracking gaps across platforms and devices. * Maintain offline conversion integrations (CRM, call\-center, in\-person) into ad platforms. * Partner with Engineering to ensure clean data pipelines, accurate attribution, and real\-time lead flow into CRM systems. ### **What We’re Looking For** * 5\+ years in performance/growth marketing with proven channel ownership (Google Ads, Meta). * Full\-stack marketing operator: You work across strategy, execution, analysis, and tooling. * Strong communicator: You turn complex data into clear action for stakeholders at all levels. *Nice\-to\-Have:* experience in SaaS, B2B or telecom verticals. ### **How We’ll Measure Success** * **Hit monthly revenue targets:** Test and grow campaigns to hit monthly revenue milestones. * **Drive Checkout Online Growth:** Ensure people understand the product they are buying and can make a decision without entering the sales funnel. **Community Phone Culture** =========================== Community Phone has a customer\-obsessed culture. We are looking for team members who love our product and mission. Beyond the job description, here are some traits members of our team share: We value **Curiosity** and learning in our employees. We promote open\-mindedness, embrace mistakes, and encourage challenging questions for personal growth. We create a culture of continuous learning to empower our team to tackle challenges and excel in their roles. **Efficiency Where it Counts**. We operate lean, optimizing resources to improve our products and deliver a world\-class customer experience. We prioritize value over excess, embodying a scrappy and resourceful spirit to achieve our mission and values. We prioritize taking decisive action over deliberation, recognizing that building a world\-class product requires pushing personal limits and taking risks. We believe that a **Bias Toward Action** is essential for achieving our goals and delivering exceptional results to our customers. We strive for **Transparency** and prioritize open, Direct communication. This helps us resolve issues quickly and build strong relationships with our stakeholders. We take our work seriously and see it as a reflection of who we are. We're always looking for ways to improve and are open to feedback. We approach our work with a sense of ownership and a desire to deliver the best possible results. By embodying a **Founder Mindset**, we're able to achieve our goals and create exceptional products. We value a **Caring Mentality**. Our customers come first, and we collaborate to provide exceptional service. We prioritize teamwork over personal accolades, fostering a customer\-focused culture that drives our success and promotes a supportive work environment. **The pay range for this role is:** 110,000 \- 140,000 USD per year(Remote (United States))

jobs.title: Sr Growth Product Manager
jobs.description: **About Community Phone Company** --------------------------------- Community Phone Company YC W19 built a simple cloud phone system for businesses that don't operate a call center. Our solution lets a business get all modern voice features (re\-route if busy, greeting menu and IVR, programmable caller ID, cloud voicemail, etc) on their existing office phone and existing employee cell phones. All employees onboard instantly, no wifi required, no app to download. Businesses should not be missing out on orders because they can only take one call at a time, and they shouldn't need an IT person in order to get a modern business phone system. **About the role** ------------------ ### **The company** Communications for the aging in America is broken. Seniors are isolated. Their families are anxious in ways that go far beyond "I hope mom's alright." James Graham started this company after seeing his own grandmother get taken advantage of by the large telecom hegemony. They are checking her bank account daily because they cannot tell if she is being scammed. They are calling three times a day because she did not pick up and they do not know if she is okay. They are lying awake wondering if she is connected to anyone, or just sitting alone. And at the most basic level, a lot of their phone service is completely unreliable or breaks entirely for the family once she reaches a certain age. There are 55 million Americans over 65 living at home. Most of them, and most of their families, are navigating this alone. Community Phone is fixing that. We built a phone so simple it works out of the box, no setup required. We wrapped it with AI\-powered check\-in calls that surface how she is really doing. And we built a family app that replaces daily dread with genuine safety and peace of mind. It is working. We are well into 8\-figure subscription ARR, pacing to 9\-figure, with 25,000\+ families trusting us with something that matters deeply to them. Customers stay. They refer their friends. They tell us we took away an anxiety they had carried for years. We are a lean, product\-driven team. The people who thrive here take full ownership, are mission\-driven, move quickly, and care deeply about the customer. One of our product engineers won an Oscar for best foreign film, one team member is a Thiel Fellow, one is a Harvard Philosophy PhD dropout, others are the first growth hires at now Unicorn companies, other of our product engineers are former leaders of 60\+ person engineering organizations, and many are former founders. ### **The opportunity** We have 25,000\+ families paying us every month for something they deeply value. Churn is low. NPS is high. The upsell products are built and ready. What does not exist yet is the motion to move customers into them: the trigger identification, the experiment infrastructure, the lifecycle sequences, the in\-product moments that surface the right product at the right time to a customer who already trusts us. That is what this role builds. From scratch. Owned entirely by you. With a clear revenue target, a strong data foundation, and a direct line to product leadership and the CEO. In year one, the PLG expansion opportunity alone is in the low millions of ARR. That is not a stretch goal requiring new customers or new channels. It is sitting in the base we already have, waiting for the right motion. And that is just year one. The bigger picture: we are building the definitive platform for aging in place. Phone service is the wedge. Check\-in calls, the family app, and products we have not built yet are the expansion. The PM who builds the upsell motion now is building the system that monetizes everything that comes after it. ### **What you will own** * Expansion revenue from our consumer subscriber base, measured in ARR * The full upsell motion: trigger identification, experiment design, in\-product nudges, lifecycle sequences, pricing page, and onboarding flows * A prioritized roadmap of PLG experiments, run with shared engineering resources and a strong bias toward non\-eng levers where possible * The reporting and learning loop that makes each experiment smarter than the last ### **What we are looking for** You have run PLG or lifecycle\-driven upsell experiments in a consumer subscription business before. You know what a good experiment looks like, you can build a basic framework to run them, and you can read results clearly without needing a data team to hand\-hold you. You are comfortable without a dedicated engineering team. You find leverage in copy, sequencing, onboarding design, and pricing structure before you write a single ticket. When you do need eng, you prioritize hard and make the case clearly. You have owned a revenue metric, not just shipped features. You know what it feels like to have a number that is yours. One thing makes this role unusual: the customer is a senior or a caregiver, not a typical tech\-forward subscriber. Standard PLG playbooks do not translate directly here. The PM who wins will develop real intuition for this audience and design upsell moments that feel like help, not pressure. That is a genuine creative constraint on top of the analytical work, and we think it is one of the most interesting parts of the job. ### **You are probably a fit if** * You have 4\+ years of product experience with at least 3 in a growth or monetization role * You have worked in consumer subscription, not just B2B SaaS * You can point to a specific experiment you ran, what you learned, and what it moved * You are energized by owning a number, not just a roadmap * You are both comfortable with ambiguity and heavily biased toward action * You communicate clearly and understand fine distinctions quickly in structures or philosophies **First 14 days: Diagnose and ship in parallel** You have one week to become the most informed person at the company on why customers are not upgrading. Pull every relevant data cut yourself. Listen to recorded calls. Talk directly to customers who upgraded and customers who did not. Pressure\-test every assumption the team holds about the expansion funnel. You are not waiting until the diagnosis is complete to start moving. By day 15 the first experiment is live. Not scoped. Not in review. Live. You will have access to dedicated eng resources. **Days 15 to 60: Build the operation** You are mapping every sub\-funnel in the expansion motion and measuring each one. A dashboard exists and is being used. By day 60 you have a clear, written point of view on every sub\-funnel: which ones have momentum, which ones are dead ends, which ones need more signal before you commit. The ones with momentum have active hypotheses shipping into them continuously. Not queued. Shipping. By day 60 the primary measure is revenue. Not experiments run, not hypotheses tested. Actual expansion ARR moving in the right direction with a model that shows how you get to the year\-one number. **Days 61 to 90: Accelerate** The system is running. Your job in month three is to make it faster. More experiments per week, sharper prioritization, first significant eng bets in market. You know which sub\-funnels to press and which to deprioritize. The 90\-day review is not a check\-in. It is a growth review with a live forecast, a clear point of view on the year, and a backlog that reflects real conviction about where the leverage is. The bar at 90 days: anyone in the room should be able to look at your dashboard and your forecast and understand exactly where the money is coming from and why. ### **The team and structure** You will report to our CEO and work day\-to\-day with the growth team, lifecycle lead, and engineers. You will have high visibility to the CEO. This is a small team, which means your work shows up fast and your judgment matters immediately. ### **Why now** 55 million seniors. A platform they trust. Products that genuinely improve their lives and their families' peace of mind. A base that is growing every month. The customers are there. The products are there. The data foundation is there. What has been missing is one person whose entire job is to systematically close the gap between what customers have and what they should have. If you want to own a number that matters, build something from scratch, and do it at a company with a mission you can actually feel, this is the role.

jobs.title: Converge Signals, FSI - Engineering Lead_Products & Platforms
jobs.description: **The Team** The Innovation \& Delivery Transformation (I\&DT) team is building the future of Deloitte's business through new AI\-native platforms and products. The team is responsible for identifying, nurturing, scaling, and winning in new markets through new capabilities. Rather than relying on what the firm has historically done, I\&DT looks ahead and invests in areas where growth is expected three, five, and ten years into the future. Are you looking for a unique opportunity with both start\-up spirit AND enterprise strength? Deloitte's Converge for FSI business offers both! We are looking for a talented Data Scientist to join the Converge for FSI team and help build differentiated, data\-driven financial services products that achieve product\-market fit. This is a great opportunity to work at the intersection of advanced analytics and financial services industry expertise, developing the models and insights that power Signals for FSI and future products in the Converge for FSI portfolio. **Position Summary** We are looking for a highly skilled and client\-facing Engineering Lead to sit at the intersection of engineering excellence and customer partnership, supporting the Signals for FSI product. Signals is a proprietary set of data assets coupled with AI, data science, and statistical models that help our clients drive business growth and power decisions in a dynamic and changing market. You'll own the architecture decisions that turn this from a collection of prototypes into a real platform: a shared data pipeline and warehouse that any app in the suite can draw from, a common geospatial/demographic data layer that scales nationally. In this role, you will partner with our product \& data science team to integrate new data sources and harden prototypes into applications based on client feedback. This is a high\-impact, high\-visibility role with direct influence on product direction. You will be part of the General Manager's leadership team, responsible for proactively bringing ideas that push the business forward, weighing in on key decisions, and helping junior resources across the team overcome hurdles. This is a build\-it\-for\-real role for someone who's done this exact transition before \- not scaling one app, but building the reusable foundation that lets a whole suite of client\-facing products scale together. Recruiting for this role ends on 12/1/2026\. **Work you'll do** As the Engineering Lead, you will work at the intersection of data science, engineering, and financial services domain expertise to build and refine the data platforms, models, and analytics that power Signals for FSI: * Rapidly prototype and build POCs using financial services datasets and data models that demonstrate value in the context of a client's real\-world use cases * Lead teams of onshore and offshore data engineers and application engineers to harden prototypes into production grade applications that satisfy the highly secure and regulated environments of financial services. * Collaborate with internal Product \& Data fabric teams to integrate new data sources and design and build scalable, production\-ready data pipelines and applications. * Partner with the Product team and client architects to translate financial services use cases into requirements, features, and application specifications. * Recognize and promote opportunities for reuse when designing prototypes and applications. * Evaluate data, model and application performance against business and regulatory considerations relevant to financial services and iterate based on findings. * Translate analytical findings into clear, business\-relevant insights for Product, Sales, and client\-facing teams to shape the technical go\-to\-market strategy. * Maintain a library of reusable demo assets, hardened applications, and reference implementations. * Stay current on emerging AI/ML techniques and financial services data trends, and evaluate their application to the Signals for FSI roadmap. * Produce high\-quality technical documentation, runbooks, and integration guides. The successful candidate would possess these skills: * Experience in building data and insights products and pipelines that power insights and signals for business users to drive growth decisions. * Demonstrated ability to take a working prototype and re\-architect it for production scale, cost, and reliability \- not just incremental feature work * Exceptional written \& verbal communicator \- able to lead technical conversations with senior engineers and C\-suite stakeholders alike; able to translate infrastructure tradeoffs for non\-technical stakeholders * Proven experience designing and scaling geospatial/location\-based data systems (spatial indexing, PostGIS, H3, or equivalent) \- ability to replace client\-side point\-in\-radius rendering with server\-side spatial queries at scale * Strong background in ETL/data pipeline engineering \- designing scheduled ingestion from third\-party dat al client outcomes. * Exposure to Agentic AI frameworks, harnesses, and tooling \- including LangGraph, LangChain, or similar orchestration frameworks * Practical understanding of LLM integration patterns, prompt engineering, and AI\-powered application design * Strong analytical rigor paired with sound judgment about when a model is ready to ship versus needing further refinement. * Comfortable moving between hands\-on technical work and clear communication with product, engineering, and business stakeholders. * Self\-directed and organized, with the ability to manage multiple analytical workstreams at once. * Collaborative mindset and a willingness to partner closely with engineering and product teams to bring models into production. * Comfortable working through ambiguous, messy problems that require creativity and persistence. **Qualifications** Required: * Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Statistics, Data Science, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field. * 7\+ years of software engineering experience, including 3\+ years in a technical lead or architecture role * Ability to travel 10\-25%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve. * Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future. Preferred: * Advanced degree (Master's) in Engineering, Computer Science, Statistics, Data Science, Mathematics, or a related field. * 2\+ years of experience working with financial services data (e.g., banking, capital markets, or insurance) or delivering analytics solutions to financial services clients. * Experience with cloud\-based data and analytics platforms (e.g., Snowflake, Databricks, AWS, Google Cloud, or Azure) in a financial services or other highly regulated industry context. * Familiarity with risk, fraud, credit, or customer analytics use cases within banking, capital markets, or insurance. * Experience with feature stores or ML feature engineering pipelines, particularly for on\-demand/real\-time scoring rather than static precomputed datasets * Background in financial services or another regulated industry, with working knowledge of data vendor licensing/compliance constraints (e.g., credit bureau or B2B data providers) * Experience with LLM/agent infrastructure (LangChain, LLM gateways) including cost monitoring and latency observability * Familiarity with FDIC, Census, or similar public geospatial/demographic datasets * Experience building internal developer platforms or paved\-road tooling that other engineering teams consume * Prior experience taking a product from single\-region/regional pilot to national or multi\-region scale * Experience with observability stacks (e.g., Datadog, Grafana, OpenTelemetry) for both application and ML/LLM monitoring * Background in a startup, management consulting, commercial transformation, or enterprise technology product leadership, ideally with a data focus (e.g. Epsilon, TransUnion, Equifax, Experian, Axciom) The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $141,200\-$278,300\. You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

jobs.title: ConvergeCONSUMER, Backend DevOps_Products & Platforms
jobs.description: **The Team** ConvergeCONSUMER™ is a product\-driven business that combines differentiated consumer insights with robust prediction and optimization capabilities to help consumer\-focused businesses improve decision\-making and deliver personalized experiences to drive growth, consumer loyalty, and profitability. We operate with the speed and agility of a startup within the world's largest professional services firm. We drive value for our clients by optimizing decisions and actions at a level of granularity only made possible with today's data and technology. ConvergeCONSUMER's suite of solutions helps consumer\-facing businesses prosper in a world being re\-shaped by convergence, where the lines between industries, competitors and collaborators, consumers and suppliers, and even human and artificial intelligence have blurred. **Position Summary** Are you the person people call when a delivery\-blocking issue needs to be found fast? As a Backend DevOps \& UAT Engineer on ConvergeCONSUMER, you'll be the technical backstop for our product delivery teams \- troubleshooting backend issues, owning UAT coordination, and making sure problems get tracked to resolution instead of falling through the cracks. Recruiting for this role ends on 11/30/2026\. **Work you'll do** As the Backend DevOps \& UAT Engineer, you will: * Troubleshoot backend issues surfacing during product delivery and client implementations, working across environments to isolate root cause * Own User Acceptance Testing (UAT) coordination for product releases, catching and resolving issues before go\-live * Escalate and track defects and delivery blockers across engineering, delivery, and product teams until resolved * Build and maintain test scripts and scenarios to validate backend functionality ahead of releases * Partner with delivery teams to validate environment configuration, data, and integration issues during implementations * Support CI/CD pipeline health and flag recurring failure patterns to engineering * Document recurring issues and troubleshooting steps to build the team's shared knowledge base The successful candidate would possess these skills: * Methodical troubleshooter who can jobs.title: Software Engineer - Applications
jobs.description: **About Us** ------------ We are a well\-funded, early\-stage AI research and product lab focused on building the next generation of frontier multimodal AI models. Founded by former DeepMind researchers—including Andrew Dai, previously an engineering leader on Gemini—our mission is to push the frontier of visual and multimodal intelligence. Our first model, Glimpse, launched publicly in October 2026\. Our team currently consists of 25 world\-class scientists and engineers. We raised a $55M seed round led by Altimeter Capital, Menlo Ventures, Striker VC, and NVIDIA. We are tackling foundational problems in artificial intelligence and translating cutting\-edge multimodal research into scalable, real\-world systems. **About The Role** ------------------ As a **Software Engineer – Applications**, you will build the engineering bridge between our core multimodal research and real\-world production deployments. This is an engineering\-first, high\-impact role where you will design and implement reference architectures, production\-grade integration frameworks, developer SDKs, evaluation harnesses, and bespoke end\-to\-end applications powered by Glimpse. You will sit at the intersection of product engineering, model evaluation, and customer architecture. Working directly with founders, early enterprise partners, and our internal research team, you will turn complex multimodal requirements into robust, high\-performance systems and feed real\-world constraints directly into our model roadmaps. **What You Will Do** -------------------- * **Architect \& Build Production Integrations:** Design, build, and deploy low\-latency, scalable application architectures integrating Glimpse into complex enterprise data pipelines and high\-throughput workflows. * **Develop Reference Systems \& Tooling:** Create open\-source reference implementations, production\-ready demo applications, developer tooling, and SDK components that establish the standard for building on Glimpse. * **Build Evaluation \& Benchmarking Infrastructure:** Design and implement rigorous evaluation pipelines and benchmarking harnesses to systematically test Glimpse against other frontier multimodal models on diverse, real\-world visual datasets. * **Debug Across the Stack:** Systematically isolate and resolve bottlenecks across application pipelines, data ingestion layers, model inference APIs, and prompt/orchestration logic. * **Partner Technically with Early Adopters:** Serve as the core technical architect for engineering teams at design\-partner companies, guiding technical discovery, proof\-of\-concept development, and deployment to production. * **Influence Model \& Platform Roadmaps:** Translate real\-world application failure modes, edge cases, and performance requirements into prioritized specifications for our core research and model infrastructure teams. **What We Are Looking For** --------------------------- * **Strong Core Engineering:** 5\+ years of experience building and shipping high\-performance, production software in Python (and ideally TypeScript or Go/Rust). You write clean, maintainable code and can speak deeply to your architectural decisions. * **Hands\-on LLM/Multimodal Application Engineering:** Experience building complex systems beyond basic API calls—such as agentic workflows, structured tool\-use frameworks, model evaluation pipelines, or orchestration layers for vision\-language models. * **Model Understanding \& Evaluation:** Hands\-on experience evaluating, fine\-tuning, or benchmarking ML models. You can systematically differentiate between model failure modes, pipeline errors, and data\-quality issues. * **Full\-Lifecycle Ownership:** A builder mindset with a bias for shipping quickly. Experience as a founding engineer, startup core contributor, or forward\-deployed engineer is highly valued. * **Systems \& Data Architecture:** Familiarity with modern cloud architecture, API design, vector/multimodal indexing, streaming protocols, and handling high\-volume image/video data pipelines under tight latency and cost constraints. * **Clear Technical Communication:** Ability to communicate complex architectural tradeoffs clearly to both internal research teams and external engineering leaders. **Nice To Have** ---------------- * Prior experience at a foundation model provider, AI developer platform, or ML infrastructure company. * Direct experience building multimodal applications in vision\-heavy verticals (e.g., robotics, industrial automation, manufacturing, geospatial, medical imaging, or media production). * Experience developing public developer APIs, open\-source AI tooling, or developer ecosystems. **Logistics** ------------- * **Location:** On\-site in Palo Alto, CA * **Employment Type:** Full\-time * **Compensation**: $250,000 – $400,000 \+ significant equity \+ comprehensive health insurance and perks

jobs.title: Senior QA Engineer
jobs.description: **About FacilityOS** ==================== FacilityOS is a fast\-growing company redefining how facilities operate—bringing safety, security, and daily operations into one unified platform used by organizations around the world. As we continue to scale globally, we’re building a team of driven, curious people who want to make an impact. You’ll be part of a dynamic, collaborative culture where individuals are trusted to take ownership, solve meaningful problems, and grow in their careers. Our team comes together in\-office twice a week to connect, collaborate, and build momentum. If you’re looking to do your best work alongside a great team in a high\-growth environment, FacilityOS is the place to build your career. **About the role** We're looking for a **Senior QA Engineer** to own the quality of our web, desktop, and mobile products. You'll combine hands\-on **manual testing** with building and maintaining **automated test suites**, working closely with developers and product managers from requirements through release. You'll also play an important part in triaging and investigating issues reported by customers and Support. Our product suite includes an ASP.NET / Angular web platform, Windows desktop applications, backend services, and Android/iOS mobile apps. You'll work across all of them, and grow our automation from web and desktop into mobile. This is a hybrid position. You'll be required to come into our Annapolis, Maryland office three times a week. **Duties and Responsibilities** **Manual testing** * Review requirements, specifications, and designs, and give timely, meaningful feedback. * Plan and run functional, exploratory, regression, integration, permission, and user acceptance testing across web, desktop, and mobile applications. * Write clear test plans, test cases, and checklists using appropriate test design techniques. * Test APIs and data: validate requests and responses with API tools and check results in the database with SQL. * Find, reproduce, and document defects with clear steps and evidence, and work with developers to understand the root cause and verify fixes. **Test automation** * Design, build, and maintain automated test suites: + Web: Playwright with C\#, and SmartBear Reflect, an AI\-assisted test automation tool. + Desktop: FlaUI and Playwright for Windows desktop applications. + Mobile: Help evaluate and introduce Android (and potentially iOS) test automation. * Integrate automated tests into Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines, and keep them reliable, fast, and maintainable. * Build reusable test environments and test data, e.g. virtual machine snapshots and seeded test accounts. **Release quality and testing** * Support product releases: identify changes and risk areas, plan and run regression testing. * Track quality metrics, such as defect counts and automation coverage, and use them to improve the process. **Issue triage and investigation** * Investigate root causes of customers’ issues with developers using logs, database queries, browser and API tools, and recent code changes; Comfortable with browser developer tools (network, console). * Experience testing **web and desktop** applications. Mobile testing is a plus. * Solid knowledge of **Jira**, **Confluence**, a test management system (e.g. **Zephyr**), and **Git** / Azure DevOps. * Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, and written communication skills. You write bug reports developers can act on right away. * A high level of ownership, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently while managing multiple priorities. ### **Nice to haves:** * Security testing experience is preferred, e.g. authentication and authorization checks and OWASP concepts. * Experience with **FlaUI** or other Windows desktop UI automation. * Experience with **SmartBear Reflect** or other AI\-assisted or low\-code test tools. * Introduce mobile test automation for our Android apps: evaluate tools, then set up and grow a test suite, starting with **Appium**, on emulators and real scanner devices (e.g. Zebra, Honeywell). Experience with **Espresso / UI Automator**, **XCUITest**, or **Maestro** is a plus. * Experience with CI/CD pipelines (**Azure DevOps**), virtual machines, and test environment management. * Familiarity with **ASP.NET** **MVC / Web API**, Angular, and multi\-tenant SaaS applications. * Experience with logging and monitoring tools such as Datadog or Application Insights. * Relevant testing certifications (e.g. ISTQB). **Education** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. **Why work at FacilityOS?** We work hard and play hard and we do both with passion and respect for one another. standardization and continuous improvement initiatives across test systems and manufacturing processes. **What You'll Bring to Our Team** --------------------------------- * Bachelor of Science degree architecture, pub/sub, security, and web\-based reporting * Strong troubleshooting and root\-cause problem\-solving skills * Familiarity with instrumentation technologies including electrical, fluid, and visual inspection systems * Experience supporting electromechanical equipment projects, including supplier engagement, technical reviews, installation, and qualification * Strong planning, organization, and project execution skills * Ability to work effectively across cross\-functional teams and communicate with multiple levels of the organization * Strong oral and written communication By further embedding Zero Distance into our People and Culture framework, we will continue to build a deeply connected organization. jobs.description: **Media Infrastructure Engineer** ================================= **Location:** Raleigh, North Carolina (Hybrid) **Employment Type:** Full\-Time, Direct Hire **Salary:** $130,000–$170,000 ### **About GPL Technologies** GPL Technologies is a technology services partner specializing in the media and entertainment industry, headquartered in Los Angeles. We're partnering with a rapidly growing media production company in North Carolina to find an experienced Media Infrastructure Engineer to support its expanding production environment. ### **The Role** We're looking for a hands\-on engineer who enjoys taking ownership of infrastructure and keeping complex systems running smoothly. In this role, you'll support the technology behind a high\-volume post\-production operation, including data center infrastructure, enterprise storage, networking, and media archiving systems. This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys a mix of hands\-on engineering, troubleshooting, and improving how systems operate. You'll have the independence to manage infrastructure and solve problems while collaborating with a small technical team supporting a busy editorial environment. The position is based in the Raleigh area and combines remote systems management with regular on\-site data center work. Some travel to Greenville, NC, is also required. ### **What You'll Be Doing** **Infrastructure \& Systems** * Maintain and improve the reliability, performance, and availability of critical production infrastructure. * Handle physical infrastructure work, including server installations, equipment upgrades, cabling, and hardware maintenance. * Administer Windows and Linux servers, virtualized environments, and essential network services. * Monitor system performance, investigate incidents, and coordinate hardware or software support with vendors. **Storage, Backup \& Archiving** * Support large\-scale shared storage environments used by editorial and production teams. * Monitor storage utilization, troubleshoot performance issues, and plan for future capacity needs. * Manage media archiving and retrieval, including LTO tape libraries, data verification, and off\-site storage. * Maintain reliable backup and recovery processes to protect production assets. **Networking \& Production Support** * Troubleshoot network connectivity, bandwidth, and performance issues across production infrastructure. * Support high\-speed networks, switches, VLANs, firewalls, and related services. * Work with editorial teams to resolve technical issues affecting media access, file transfers, and production workflows. * Assist with infrastructure improvements and expansion projects. **Automation \& Improvements** * Develop scripts and tools to simplify routine administration and improve operational efficiency. * Support integrations between local infrastructure and cloud\-based storage services. * Maintain technical documentation and identify opportunities to improve reliability, scalability, and workflows. ### **What We're Looking For** * 5\+ years of experience in systems administration, infrastructure engineering, or a related technical role. * Hands\-on experience supporting servers, networking equipment, and data center infrastructure. * Strong knowledge of enterprise storage systems, including NAS/SAN technologies and shared storage environments. * Experience with LTO tape libraries, media archiving, or large\-scale backup systems. * Solid understanding of networking fundamentals, including routing, switching, VLANs, firewalls, and high\-speed connectivity. * Experience administering Linux, Windows Server, virtualization platforms, and Active Directory. * Familiarity with macOS environments and supporting creative or technical users. * Experience with scripting or automation using Python, Bash, PowerShell, or similar tools. * Strong troubleshooting skills and the ability to work independently. * Ability to communicate effectively with both technical teams and nontechnical users. * Based in Raleigh, NC, or willing to relocate, with availability for on\-site work and occasional travel. ### **Nice to Have** * Experience in media production, post\-production, broadcast, VFX, or animation. * Familiarity with storage platforms such as Qumulo, PowerScale/Isilon, Avid NEXIS, or SNS EVO. * Experience with archive solutions such as Spectra Logic, Quantum, Archiware, or SGL. * Knowledge of Adobe Premiere Pro or other professional editing applications. * Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, or GCP), media asset management systems, or file transfer technologies. * Relevant networking, storage, or cloud certifications. **Experience in media and entertainment is a plus, but we're also interested in strong infrastructure engineers from other industries who are eager to work in a production environment.** ### **Compensation \& Benefits** This is a full\-time, direct\-hire opportunity with our client. * Competitive base salary of $130,000–$170,000, depending on experience * Medical, dental, and vision insurance * Life insurance and HSA contributions * 401(k) with employer matching * Flexible paid time off and company holidays * Company\-provided technology and equipment * Relocation assistance available for qualified candidates GPL Technologies is committed to providing equal employment opportunities throughout the recruitment process. jobs.title: Principal UI/UX Designer - Analytical Products (Minneapolis preferred, remote eligible)
jobs.description: **COMPANY OVERVIEW** We exist to make food the world loves. But we do more than that. Our company is a place that prioritizes being a force for good, a place to expand learning, explore new perspectives and reimagine new possibilities, every day. We look for people who want to bring their best — bold thinkers with big hearts who challenge one another and grow together. Because becoming the undisputed leader in food means surrounding ourselves with people who are hungry for what’s next. **JOB OVERVIEW** We’re passionate about food and driven by data. Technology and analytics play a critical role in how we grow iconic brands and make better business decisions across General Mills. The Business Intelligence \& Analytics team delivers enterprise analytics capabilities across the company, building dashboards, AI\-enabled analytics experiences, and decision\-support products in partnership with business, data engineering, and data science teams. The Principal UX/UI Designer – Analytics Products will serve as the enterprise design expert for analytics experiences at General Mills. This role owns the overall user experience for analytics products across both traditional BI and emerging AI\-enabled workflows, helping define how dashboards, guided analytics, conversational experiences, AI summarization, and insight\-to\-action journeys fit together into a coherent and effective user experience. This person will shape design standards, drive product experience strategy, and partner across product, engineering, BI, and data science to ensure analytics products are intuitive, trustworthy, scalable, and aligned to how users actually make decisions. **KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES** * Own the end\-to\-end experience strategy, UX, and UI design for analytics products, including dashboards, self\-service analytics, AI\-assisted summarization, conversational analytics, and insight exploration workflows. * Define how AI and traditional analytics experiences work together, including when users should explore data directly, ask questions in natural language, review AI\-generated outputs, and move into deeper analysis or action\-taking workflows. * Design intuitive, elegant workflows for complex, information\-dense enterprise experiences, simplifying technical concepts and reducing friction for business users. * Create templates and reusable design patterns and standards for analytics UX, including navigation, data visualization, information architecture, conversational patterns, prompt interactions, feedback states, trust indicators, and error handling. * Partner closely with product managers, BI leaders, engineers, data scientists, and business stakeholders to translate analytics and AI capabilities into useful, usable product experiences. * Lead user discovery, workflow mapping, prototyping, usability testing, and iterative refinement to ensure analytics products solve real user problems and fit naturally into day\-to\-day decision\-making. * Shape the experience strategy for AI\-enabled analytics, with emphasis on trust, explainability, transparency, confidence states, human\-in\-the\-loop interactions, and responsible presentation of AI\-generated insights. * Design some in\-experience guardrails to support responsible user actions stemming from AI for BI interactions. * Drive alignment between user needs, product vision, and enterprise standards by influencing roadmaps, prioritization, and cross\-functional design decisions. * Create and evolve design\-system guidance for analytics products so teams can scale high\-quality experiences consistently across platforms and use cases. * Serve as the internal thought leader on design for analytics products, advising teams on best practices in UX, UI, workflow design, and user\-centered product development. **MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS** * Bachelor’s degree in Human\-Computer Interaction, Product Design, UX/UI Design, Interaction Design, Psychology, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field. * 8\+ years of experience in UX, UI, product design, or interaction design, with increasing responsibility for complex digital products. * Demonstrated expertise designing analytics, dashboard, data visualization, or other data\-rich product experiences. * Familiarity with conversational analytics, natural\-language querying, AI summarization, or agent\-assisted workflow patterns. * Experience designing AI\-enabled, conversational, assistive, or adaptive product experiences. * Proven ability to simplify complex workflows and design intuitive user experiences for information\-dense products. * Deep proficiency in Figma (or similar technology), wireframing, prototyping, interaction design, and modern design\-system practices. * Strong communication and stakeholder\-influence skills, including the ability to explain design rationale clearly and influence without direct authority while partnering effectively with internal product managers, engineering, and technical stakeholders to ensure high\-quality product experiences. * Portfolio demonstrating strong visual craft, systems thinking, workflow design, and measurable product impact. **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** * 10\+ years of relevant experience across product design, enterprise UX, analytics products, or adjacent digital product roles. * Strong experience designing enterprise software, SaaS products, internal tools, or other workflow\-heavy applications with AI\-enabled, conversational, assistive, or adaptive product tools. * Experience building or scaling enterprise design systems and reusable UX standards across multiple products or teams. * Strong user research and usability\-testing background, especially for enterprise or internal products with complex workflows. * Familiarity with front\-end development concepts and technical constraints that influence digital product design decisions. * Experience working in a matrixed, global enterprise environment. Experience in analytics, BI, data platforms, semantic layers, governed datasets, or AI\-for\-BI environments. * **ADDITIONAL CONSIDERATION** * Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the U.S. General Mills will not sponsor applicants for a U.S. work visa. * International relocation or international remote working arrangements (outside of the US) will not be considered. **SALARY RANGE** The salary range for this position is: $149,500 \- $249,300 Annual At General Mills we strive for each employee's pay at any point in their career to reflect their experiences performance and skills for their current role. The salary range for this role represents the numerous factors considered in the hiring decisions including, but not limited to, educations, skills, work experience, certifications, etc. As such, pay for the successful candidate(s) could fall anywhere within the stated range. Beyond base salary, General Mills offers a competitive Total Rewards package focusing on your overall well\-being. We are proud to offer a foundation of health benefits, retirement and financial wellbeing, time off programs, wellbeing support and perks. Benefits may vary by role, country, region, union status, and other employment status factors. You may also be eligible to participate in an annual incentive program. An incentive award, if any, depends on various factors, including, individual and organizational performance. **ELIGIBILITY** Applicants must meet a minimum 18\-year age qualification. **EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER (EOE)** General Mills is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, marital or familial status, status regarding public assistance, or membership or activity in a local human rights commission. **REASONABLE ACCOMMODATION REQUEST** If you need to request an accommodation during the application or hiring process, please fill out our online accommodation request form by following this link: Accommodation Request .

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: About GitHub: GitHub is the world’s leading platform for agentic software development — powered by Copilot to build, scale, and deliver secure software. Over 180 million developers, including more than 90% of the Fortune 100 companies, use GitHub to collaborate, and more than 77,000 organisations have adopted GitHub Copilot. Locations: In this role you can work from Remote, United States Overview: As a software engineer at GitHub, you will enhance the collaboration experience at GitHub by working closely with a community of engineers and designers with a distributed, diverse and passionate team delivering the services that millions of developers depend on. In this role you will design, prototype, implement, ship and support highly performant and inspiring user experiences with your team. We are looking for creative problem solvers and diverse thinkers, people who care about culture as well as customers and features. We believe that how we do things is as important as what we do. Big vision, a common purpose, passion for quality, curiosity, dedication, and investment in fun and collaboration are what lead to great results. Great products reflect the teams that build them. Responsibilities: * Design, develop, test and ship high\-quality technical solutions that scale across multiple GitHub services. * Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to define and implement innovative solutions. * Provide technical leadership, mentorship, pairing opportunities, and code reviews to encourage the growth of others. * Own and advocate for the health and quality of the systems that the team builds, including participating in on\-call and first responder rotations * Write architecture briefs and proposals, carry out code experiments, and build prototypes to learn how we can achieve planetary scale with our systems * Design and implement APIs to facilitate seamless integration between software components * Utilize CI/CD tools to set up automated pipelines for continuous integration and delivery * Become intimately familiar with the systems you build and take pride in writing maintainable code. Qualifications: **Required Qualifications*** 6\+ years experience in Software Engineering, Computer Science, or related technical discipline with proven experience maintaining and delivering production software coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C\+\+, C\#, Java, JavaScript, Go, Ruby, Rust, or Python + OR Associate’s Degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Math, Physics, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related field AND 5\+ years experience in Software Engineering, Computer Science, or related technical discipline with proven experience maintaining and delivering production software coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C\+\+, C\#, Java, JavaScript, Go, Ruby, Rust, or Python + OR Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Math, Physics, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related field AND 4\+ years experience in Software Engineering, Computer Science, or related technical discipline with proven experience maintaining and delivering production software coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C\+\+, C\#, Java, JavaScript, Go, Ruby, Rust, or Python + OR Master's Degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Math, Physics, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related field AND 2\+ years experience in Software Engineering, Computer Science, or related technical discipline with proven experience maintaining and delivering production software coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C\+\+, C\#, Java, JavaScript, Go, Ruby, Rust, or Python + OR Doctorate in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Math, Physics, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related fie + OR equivalent experience. Compensation Range: The base salary range for this job is USD $124,000\.00 \- USD $329,200\.00 /Yr. These pay ranges are intended to cover roles based across the United States. An individual's base pay depends on various factors including geographical location and review of experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant. At GitHub certain roles are eligible for benefits and additional rewards, including annual bonus and stock. These rewards are allocated based on individual impact in role. In addition, certain roles also have the opportunity to earn sales incentives based on revenue or utilization, depending on the terms of the plan and the employee's role. This position will be open for a minimum of 3 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled. GitHub Leadership Principles: **GitHub values** * Customer\-obsessed * Ship to learn * Growth mindset * Own the outcome * Better together * Diverse and inclusive **Manager fundamentals** * Model * Coach * Care **Leadership principles** * Create clarity * Generate energy * Deliver success Who We Are: GitHub is the world’s leading AI\-powered developer platform with 150 million developers and counting. We’re also home to the biggest open\-source community on earth (and 99% of the world’s software has open\-source code in its DNA). Many of the apps and programs you use every day are built on GitHub. Our teams are dreamers, doers, and pioneers, leading the way in AI, driving humanitarian efforts around the globe, and even sending open source to Mars (and beyond!). At GitHub, our goal is to create the space you need to do your best work. We’re remote\-first and offer competitive pay, generous learning and growth opportunities, and excellent benefits to support you, wherever you are—because we know that people flourish when they can work on their own terms. Join us, and let’s change the world, together. EEO Statement: GitHub is made up of people from a wide variety of backgrounds and lifestyles. We embrace diversity and invite applications from people of all walks of life. We don't discriminate against employees or applicants based on gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, race, religion, age, national origin, citizenship, disability, pregnancy status, veteran status, or any other differences. Also, if you have a disability, please let us know if there's any way we can make the interview process better for you; we're happy to accommodate!

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Google Workspace, AI/ML
jobs.description: In most instances, this position requires in\-person interviews as part of the hiring process.### **Minimum qualifications:** * Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience. * 8 years of experience in software development. * 5 years of experience leading Machine Learning (ML) design and optimizing ML infrastructure (e.g., model deployment, model evaluation, data processing, debugging, fine tuning). * 5 years of experience testing, and launching software products. * 3 years of experience with software design and architecture. ### **Preferred qualifications:** * 8 years of experience with data structures and algorithms. * 3 years of experience in a technical leadership role leading project teams and setting technical direction. * 3 years of experience working in an organization involving cross\-functional, or cross\-business projects. **About the job** ----------------- Google Cloud's software engineers develop the next\-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large\-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google Cloud's needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast\-paced business grow and evolve. You will anticipate our customer needs and be empowered to act like an owner, take action and innovate. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full\-stack as we continue to push technology forward. Gmail Trust and Compliance Infrastructure's mission is to build and maintain infrastructure to keep Gmail and Chat data secure, and to enable rapid development of GenAI based features in Gmail, Workspace and across Google. The team builds services and pipelines that ensure safety, compliance and the processing of all of Gmail data at scale. Gmail is one of the largest consumer products in the world. This large scale brings unique issues for any technology we use. The team builds and maintains batch and incremental processing infrastructure that can reliably process all of Gmail data within tight Service Level Objectives (SLOs), to power key features for our customers. AI will change the future of work in profound ways, and our products— Gmail, Docs, Drive, Calendar, Sheets, Vids and Meet are at the forefront. From pre\-computed summaries for email threads, summaries for meetings, and videos created from a document using lifelike AI avatars, our AI opportunity is huge. Our mission is to meaningfully connect people so they can create, build, and grow together and as part of the team you can build how productivity tools should work 5\-10 years into the future.
