jobs.title: Technical Lead, SWE
jobs.description: **About Kastle** ---------------- Kastle is building the AI employee for banks. We work with some of America's financial institutions, helping them scale their contact center and compliance operations with autonomous AI agents that process payments, originate loans, and guide customers through the biggest financial decisions of their lives. We've processed over $2 billion in transactions, just raised a $24M Series A, and are backed by Insight Partners and Y Combinator. If you want to build AI that works in the real world, where precision, reliability, and performance matter, and help redefine access to credit, read on. **The Role:** ------------- As Technical Lead, you'll own the technical direction of the systems behind Kastle's real\-time AI voice and compliance agents, and lead the engineers who build them. You'll stay hands\-on in the code while setting architecture, raising the engineering bar, and turning ambitious product goals into reliable systems running inside bank environments. This is a player\-coach role: roughly half your time writing and reviewing code, half designing systems, mentoring, and partnering with product, forward\-deployed engineering, and customers. **What you'll do** ------------------ * **Set technical direction.** Own the architecture of the core platform powering real\-time AI voice and compliance workflows, and make the key build\-vs\-buy and design calls. * **Lead and grow the team.** Mentor engineers (this is a player coach role), run design and code reviews, and help hire the next wave of engineers as we scale after our Series A. * **Push performance boundaries.** Hold the line on sub\-700ms voice latency using event\-driven architecture and parallel processing. * **Run reliable systems at scale.** Deploy, operate, and scale resilient services on Kubernetes and distributed subsystems, with the observability and on\-call practices banks expect. * **Build a self\-improving AI system.** Design the feedback loops that let our agents get better with every customer interaction and human review. * **Ship fast, ship right.** Take projects from whiteboard to live production in bank environments, balancing velocity with security and compliance. * **Partner across the company.** Work with product, forward\-deployed engineers, and customers to turn real lender workflows into technical roadmaps. **What you bring** ------------------ * 7\+ years building high\-performance, real\-time backend systems (we work primarily in Python). * 2\+ years leading engineers as a tech lead, staff engineer, or engineering manager, with a track record of shipping large systems through a team. * Deep understanding of distributed systems, reliability, and fault tolerance. * Excellent database design and performance optimization skills. * Hands\-on experience running production workloads on Kubernetes and cloud infrastructure. * Clear written and verbal communication; you can explain trade\-offs to engineers, executives, and bank stakeholders alike. * A bias for ownership and the ability to figure things out in messy, high\-velocity environments. **Nice to have** ---------------- * Experience training, designing, or building production AI/ML systems, especially LLM agents or real\-time voice (speech\-to\-text, text\-to\-speech, telephony). * Experience in fintech, banking, or other regulated industries (SOC 2, PCI, data privacy). * Previous startup or founder experience, ideally scaling a team from early stage through Series A/B. **The interview process** ------------------------- We respect your time. Our process is short and designed to show how you think and lead: * 15\-min call with our Talent Lead to learn more about the role * 1\-hour live coding session with a Founding Engineer * 1\-hour system design and technical leadership conversation with the CTO * 1\-day onsite with the team **Why join Kastle** ------------------- * Work with a world\-class team building a generational AI company that will redefine how every loan in America is made and managed. * Move fast with real impact: add a feature in a few days and ship it to top 10 lenders the next week, reaching millions of customers. * Shape the engineering org: high ownership and direct input on architecture, team culture, and how engineering scales. * Competitive compensation plus meaningful equity at a high\-growth company.

Provides an efficient process for settling indemnity claims and service refunds for insured mail, improving customer satisfaction and operational efficiency. CICRS is designed to pay or deny indemnity claims against the Postal Service when there is loss or damage to insured articles in the mail stream. testing suites across the software lifecycle, utilizing Playwright for end\-to\-end and functional testing, alongside unit, regression, and performance frameworks. **DevOps \& Continuous Delivery:** applications. * Must expertise with Kubernates, containerized micro\-services, event\-driven application with Kafka. * Must experience in writing functional tests with automation testing framework, like Playwright **Required Experience** * **7\+ years** of professional Java software development experience, including at least **3 years** in full\-stack engineering. * Proven track record architecting, developing, and supporting enterprise web applications and high\-throughput batch systems. * Strong hands\-on experience with Oracle database design, complex SQL query development, and ORM persistence using Hibernate within the Spring Framework. * Solid background in cloud engineering, deployment automation, and DevOps workflows on AWS. * Comprehensive experience implementing test automation across unit, functional, regression, and performance testing suites. * Hands\-on experience developing automated end\-to\-end test suites using Playwright and integrating them into Jenkins CI/CD pipelines. * Demonstrated experience delivering software within Agile/Scrum frameworks using VersionOne (Digital.ai Agility). **Required Technical Skills** * **Core Java \& Frameworks:** jobs.title: Forward Deployment Engineer - Advanced - 5G/6G/NTN
jobs.description: Overview: Keysight is a mission\-critical design enablement partner for organizations solving the world’s most complex engineering challenges. With deep engineering expertise and leading design, emulation, and test solutions, our \~16,800 employees help customers in over 100 countries accelerate innovation across communications, automotive, energy, quantum, aerospace and defense, semiconductor, and artificial intelligence markets. Learn more about what we do. At Keysight, people come together to explore new ideas, challenge what's possible, and advance the technologies defining the future. Here, you'll find opportunities to do your best work, take your career further, and thrive in an award\-winning culture. Learn more about our benefits. Responsibilities: **About the Role** Keysight is seeking a highly skilled Wireless Software Engineer with deep wireless protocol expertise to join our Forward Deployment Engineer team. The individual will work at the forefront of 5G\-Advanced and next\-generation wireless technologies. This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys solving complex protocol challenges, developing production\-quality software, and collaborating directly with leading wireless technology companies. You will work closely with customer engineering teams and Keysight R\&D to develop, customize, integrate, and optimize software solutions used in the development of next\-generation wireless systems. Unlike traditional support or deployment roles, you will actively contribute code, debug protocol stack behavior, build software features, and drive technical solutions that influence both customer products and Keysight technology roadmaps. This is a highly development\-focused role requiring strong software engineering expertise and deep knowledge of 3GPP wireless protocols. Successful candidates will be comfortable investigating issues across multiple protocol layers, performing root\-cause analysis, modifying production code, and developing software enhancements that directly address customer and product requirements. You will have the opportunity to influence both customer solutions and future Keysight product capabilities by translating field challenges into product enhancements, software innovations, and new technical approaches. **What You'll Do** * Design, develop, and enhance software features within wireless communication systems and protocol stacks. * Develop production\-quality software in C/C\+\+ and Python for Linux\-based environments. * Analyze and debug complex issues across Layer 1 (PHY), Layer 2 (MAC/RLC/PDCP), and Layer 3 (RRC/NAS) protocols. * Investigate and troubleshoot issues across the full protocol stack, including areas outside your primary domain expertise, collaborating with development teams to drive root\-cause resolution. * Diagnose and resolve complex issues encountered during customer deployments, integrations, and performance optimization activities. * Modify existing software and develop new code to address customer\-specific requirements and technical challenges. * Develop APIs, software tools, automation frameworks, and diagnostics that improve development productivity and system visibility. * Analyze signaling logs, traces, packet captures, performance metrics, and timing behavior to identify root causes of system issues. * Build prototypes and rapidly validate new features and protocol enhancements. * Enhance existing Keysight software through feature development, performance improvements, and customer\-driven innovations. * Participate in code reviews and contribute to software quality, maintainability, and engineering best practices. * Develop a deep understanding of Keysight software architecture, feature implementation, and protocol stack behavior to effectively diagnose and resolve complex technical issues. * Collaborate closely with Keysight R\&D teams to translate field findings into product improvements, software enhancements, and new capabilities. * Lead technical discussions with customers and provide guidance on protocol implementation, system architecture, and performance optimization. * Contribute to software releases, validation activities, and deployment of new features into customer development environments. Qualifications: **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field. * 4 to 5 years of experience in software development for wireless communication systems. * Strong software development experience in C/C\+\+ and Python. * Experience developing software in Linux environments. * Solid understanding of 4G LTE, 5G NR, or 5G\-Advanced technologies. * Deep understanding of 3GPP protocols across Layers 1\-3, particularly RRC and NAS. * Hands\-on software development experience within one or more wireless protocol stack layers, including PHY, MAC, RLC, PDCP, RRC, or NAS. * Proven experience as an R\&D, platform, systems, or protocol\-stack development enginee d protocol issues across multiple layers of the wireless stack. * Strong root\-cause analysis and debugging skills using logs, traces, packet captures, signaling analysis, performance metrics, and software debugging tools. * Familiarity with 3GPP specifications and wireless protocol implementation. * Strong understanding of software architecture and development processes, with the ability to understand, modify, and extend existing codebases. * Experience participating in code reviews and working within collaborative software development environments. * Ability to design, develop, test, and deliver production\-quality software. * Strong problem\-solving, communication, and collaboration skills. **Ideal Candidate** The ideal candidate combines deep wireless protocol expertise with strong hands\-on software development skills and a demonstrated ability to design, implement, debug, and enhance production software systems. jobs.title: Senior Lead, Software Engineering - Development
jobs.description: **Who We Are** At Kyndryl, we design, build, manage and modernize the mission\-critical technology systems that the world depends on every day. So why work at Kyndryl? We are always moving forward – always pushing ourselves to go further in our efforts to build a more equitable, inclusive world for our employees, our customers and our communities. **The Role** Do you want to help modernize mission\-critical systems and build scalable, modern software? As a technical leader within Kyndryl’s App Dev, Data \& AI team, you will guide the design and delivery of key enterprise solutions. In this role, supporting initiatives for clients like the Arizona Department of Transportation (ADOT), you will connect high\-volume core platforms with cloud\-native applications to deliver resilient, scalable products. Your hands\-on backend expertise (Java, Python, or .NET), alongside practical knowledge of microservices, RESTful APIs, and databases (relational and NoSQL), will drive development forward. Beyond writing clean code, designing components, and troubleshooting across the full SDLC, you will conduct code reviews, define technical standards, and mentor fellow engineers. You will translate complex requirements into clean architectural designs, help refactor legacy logic for containerized and cloud environments, run product demos, and partner closely with cross\-functional teams to deliver dependable software. If you enjoy pairing hands\-on engineering with technical leadership to drive real\-world modernization, this is the role for you! **Your Future at Kyndryl** At Kyndryl, we invest directly in your growth. You can expect dedicated mentorship, collaborative peers, and continuous learning opportunities to keep your technical edge sharp. Joining our team gives you the chance to work on high\-impact projects, pursue certifications across major cloud providers (AWS, Azure, GCP), and expand your expertise in modern DevOps and container orchestration. Kyndryl currently does not require employees to be fully vaccinated against COVID\-19, however, if you are hired to work at a client, customer, or partner location, you may be required to show proof of vaccination to align with their respective COVID\-19 vaccination policies. Those who believe they are eligible may apply for a medical or religious accommodation prior to the start of employment. **Who You Are** You bring strong technical expertise and the track record to back it up. Just as importantly, you bring a growth mindset, take pride in client success, and thrive in an inclusive, collaborative team environment. **Required Technical and Professional Expertise** * Proven software engineering experience delivering enterprise\-scale solutions * Strong coding and debugging skills in modern backend technologies (Java, Python, .NET, or equivalent) * Solid grasp of software development practices, OOP principles, and design patterns * Hands\-on experience with relational and NoSQL databases, RESTful web services, and data formats (JSON/XML) * Practical foundation in microservices, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and messaging queues Experience guiding technical choices, running code reviews, and mentoring team members * **Preferred Technical and Professional Experience** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience * Certification in AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud (GCP) * Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, DevOps tooling, and cloud\-native practices Exposure to legacy system refactoring or cloud modernization initiatives * The compensation range for the position in the U.S. is $115,080 to $218,520 based on a full\-time schedule. Your actual compensation may vary depending on your geography, job\-related skills and experience. For part time roles, the compensation will be adjusted appropriately. The pay or salary range will not be below any applicable state, city or local minimum wage requirement. There is a different applicable compensation range for the following work locations: California (San Francisco Bay Area): $138,120 to $262,320 California (All Other): $126,600 to $240,480 Colorado: $115,080 to $218,520 Massachusetts: $115,080 to $240,480 New York City: $138,120 to $262,320 Washington: $126,600 to $240,480 Washington DC: $126,600 to $240,480 This position will be eligible for Kyndryl’s discretionary annual bonus program, based on performance and subject to the terms of Kyndryl’s applicable plans. You may also receive a comprehensive benefits package which includes medical and dental coverage, disability, retirement benefits, paid leave, and paid time off. Note: If this is a sales commission eligible role, you will be eligible to participate in a sales commission plan in lieu of the annual discretionary bonus program. Applications will be accepted on a rolling basis. **Equal Opportunity Employer** All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran. **Being You** Diversity is a whole lot more than what we look like or where we come from, it’s how we think and who we are. We welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. But we’re not doing it single\-handily: Our Kyndryl Inclusion Networks are only one of many ways we create a workplace where all Kyndryls can find and provide support and advice. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you – and everyone next to you – the ability to bring your whole self to work, individually and collectively, and support the activation of our equitable culture. That’s the Kyndryl Way. **What You Can Expect** With state\-of\-the\-art resources and Fortune 100 clients, every day is an opportunity to innovate, build new capabilities, new relationships, new processes, and new value. Kyndryl cares about your well\-being and prides itself on offering benefits that give you choice, reflect the diversity of our employees and support you and your family through the moments that matter – wherever you are in your life journey. Our employee learning programs give you access to the best learning in the industry to receive certifications, including Microsoft, Google, Amazon, Skillsoft, and many more. Through our company\-wide volunteering and giving platform, you can donate, start fundraisers, volunteer, and search over 2 million non\-profit organizations. At Kyndryl, we invest heavily in you, we want you to succeed so that together, we will all succeed. **Get Referred!** If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

jobs.title: Senior Business Analyst (AI COE)
jobs.description: This is a REMOTE role. We are unable to sponsor work authorization, now or in the future, for this role. The AI Senior Business Analyst is the domain partner who pairs directly with a Forward Deployed Engineer to automate the work of the business. You will embed in one or two functional areas at a time \- learning how the work actually gets done, mapping the workflows and pain points, and turning that understanding into a steady stream of well\-scoped solutions for your FDE to build. You are the primary feeder of work to the FDE: the person who builds AI solutions and ensures it solves a real problem the right way. In the early phases you will go deep in your first area and establish the standard operating rhythm; Later, you will take on additional areas, mentor newer Business Analysts, and codify how this model scales across the enterprise. At Lineage, the aim is not to build the largest technology team; instead, we are creating a small, highly skilled group that focuses on having the right mix of talents, skills, and the capacity to learn in areas that define our core differentiation. We leverage cloud services, best\-of\-breed libraries and components, and external teams to augment our capabilities with sufficient capacity. This means that in addition to being a firsthand technologist, you also need to be able to take a project from an ambiguous business need to a production\-grade solution, and to collaborate with internal and external partners to deliver. As a company, Lineage builds state\-of\-the\-art systems to make our employees productive, to meet and exceed our customers' expectations, to assist in our growth, and to create a technology platform that enables Lineage to achieve its vision of transforming the food supply chain. This is one of the most impactful roles in that journey, and it will require someone who has a true passion for solving real business problems with the responsible application of AI, and for raising the bar for the engineers who follow.**Primary Responsibilities:** * Embed in one or more assigned business functions and build deep working knowledge of their processes, systems, data, and pain points \- becoming the CoE's resident expert on how those areas actually operate and where AI can automate or augment the work. * Partner with functional areas to document their current\-state processes \- mapping how work flows today, where the handoffs, delays, and manual steps live \- and use that map to identify the highest\-value ways to streamline and automate the work with AI. * Act as the primary feeder of work to your paired Forward Deployed Engineer \- partnering with functional leaders and subject\-matter experts to translate the pain points you uncover into a prioritized, continuously refreshed backlog of well\-scoped solution briefs ready to build. * Develop business cases for the opportunities within your areas \- including ROI estimates, effort sizing, and risk assessments \- to support investment decisions. * Work side by side with your FDE throughout delivery \- providing domain context, documenting requirements, facilitating user acceptance testing with the business, and driving adoption once solutions ship. * Create and maintain reporting for CoE leadership that quantifies the value your pod has delivered within its areas and the health of the backlog ahead. * Collaborate with the CoE to coordinate multi\-engagement timelines, resource allocation, and stakeholder communications. * Conduct post\-deployment impact analyses to validate projected ROI and surface the next wave of opportunities within your areas. * As the team scales, take on additional functional areas, mentor junior Business Analysts, and codify the repeatable jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Overview** We are looking for a Principal Software Engineer who lives and breathes Azure Cosmos DB and knows how it is implemented underneath. Your mission is to make throttling disappear from Microsoft's AI plugin registry with fast, surgical, high\-ROI changes. Success is objective: throttling goes away, reliability goes up, and latency goes down, even as scale grows. You will see the results in days, not quarters. We are the Agent Tools and Lifecycle team in Microsoft's Copilot, Agents and Platform (CAP) organization. We build the service behind the AI plugin registry. Admins use it in the Microsoft 365 admin center to govern the plugins (skills, connectors, and agents) that extend Microsoft Copilot, and users discover and use those plugins across products such as Copilot Chat, Cowork, Teams, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint. The registry is a core part of Microsoft's AI architecture, alongside Work IQ, and Copilot experiences across Microsoft depend on it. If you use an AI solution from Microsoft, you likely are working with our service. Come join us at the center of AI transformation at Microsoft! As a hands\-on individual contributor, you will be the technical leader for the AI plugin registry's Azure Cosmos DB tier. Our catalog of plugins and agents, and the entitlements and policies that decide who can use them, live in Cosmos DB in data centers worldwide, including sovereign clouds. Traffic keeps growing as the registry expands to experiences such as Copilot Studio, GitHub Copilot, and Microsoft Foundry. Experience working on the internals of Cosmos DB or a comparable database, such as MongoDB, Amazon DynamoDB, or Apache Cassandra, and an understanding of the hardware and network limits that make them throttle, are especially valuable. Our global reach means 24/7 on\-call service. This position is based in Redmond, Washington and requires the employee be in the office a minimum of 3 days per week. Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond. **Responsibilities*** Cut request unit (RU) consumption to make throttling go away, fast. Start with the queries that use the most RUs, where we see room for 50–90% reductions: turn cross\-partition and fan\-out queries into point reads from Cosmos DB or Azure Blob Storage, batched reads, or single\-partition queries, and tune indexes. * Pick work by return on investment. Ship several targeted fixes in parallel, each within days, and measure each one in production. Take on a larger redesign only when the data shows smaller fixes cannot get there, and deliver it in steps that each pay off. * Fix hot partitions and size limits at the source: partition keys, document design, indexing policies, and API contracts that give high\-traffic calls the keys they need for point reads. When data has to move, migrate it with zero downtime across all environments, including sovereign clouds. * Decide what belongs in Cosmos DB. Move large, binary, unbounded, or rarely queried content to Azure Blob Storage or other storage, weighing latency, availability, and data\-residency needs. * Remove redundant and sequential database calls on our busiest paths with batching, request coalescing, and caching, and use retry budgets, load shedding, and graceful degradation so database pressure does not turn into failed requests. * Work with product management and the teams that call us to give each caller a throttling budget. Find callers that request the same unchanged data again and again, help them cache on their side, and lower the budgets of the heaviest callers over time. * Make success measurable: own the telemetry, dashboards, and alerts, RU use per API and per caller, partition skew, availability, and latency. Set targets, show the effect of every change, and spot limits before we hit them. * Raise the bar through AI: write AI skills that review designs and code for Cosmos DB mistakes, find high\-RU queries, and show engineers how to fix them, so your expertise scales across the team. Use agentic tools to build and validate fixes faster, following Responsible AI practices. Mentor engineers and represent us with the Azure Cosmos DB product group. * Serve as a Designated Responsible Individual (DRI) in our 24/7 on\-call rotation, lead data\-tier incident response, and turn what we learn into lasting fixes. **Qualifications** ### **Required Qualifications:** * Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 6\+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C\+\+, C\#, Java, JavaScript, or Python + OR equivalent experience. **Other Requirements:** Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or l field AND 8\+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C\+\+, C\#, Java, JavaScript, or Python + OR Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 12\+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C\+\+, C\#, Java, JavaScript, or Python + OR equivalent experience. * 4\+ years of experience building or operating large\-scale distributed databases, such as Azure Cosmos DB, MongoDB, Amazon DynamoDB, or Apache Cassandra, including partitioning, jobs.title: Senior Scientific Software Engineer — Autoresearch
jobs.description: **Summary** QuEra Computing is hiring a Senior Scientific Software Engineer to build systems that automate theoretical and computational research in quantum computing. You will develop a reusable autoresearch platform that generates hypotheses, implements and evaluates candidates, and uses accumulated evidence to guide further exploration. Initial applications include automated performance improvement across our software repositories, quantum\-error\-correction code discovery with QEC theorists, and architecture search with compiler researchers. This is a hands\-on engineering role with substantial technical ownership. You will combine classical search and optimization with AI agents, and develop methods that progressively improve the research process itself. **Responsibilities** * Design and build the autoresearch platform, including programmable search strategies, agent and tool integration, and reliable execution of long\-running experiments. * Develop and evaluate search and optimization methods for generating, selecting, refining, and combining candidates under limited computational budgets. * Collaborate with theorists and compiler researchers to translate research questions into search spaces, constraints, objectives, and executable evaluation procedures. * Establish reproducible evidence of progress through correctness checks, strong baselines, noise\-aware measurement, and independent validation; jobs.title: Engineering Operations Lead - Configuration Management & Tools
jobs.description: At REGENT, we’re on a mission to revolutionize regional transportation between coastal cities. We're not just building vehicles, we're creating a new category of transportation: the Seaglider. These groundbreaking wing\-in\-ground\-effect craft travel just above the water’s surface, combining the speed of an airplane with the low operating costs of a boat. Capable of 180 miles at 180 mph on today's battery tech (and up to 400 miles with next\-gen batteries), Seagliders will unlock fast, affordable, and sustainable coastal transit for passengers and cargo \- connecting cities, islands, and communities like never before. Backed by leading investors and powered by a team of passionate, forward\-thinking engineers, builders, and operators, we’re now scaling from a breakthrough prototype to full production \- and building the team to make it happen. **Role Overview** ================= Every part on a Seaglider has a story: who designed it, what revision was approved, what changed and why, and which one the shop floor built. As REGENT grows from prototype to certified production and moves our Viceroy program through certification, that story has to be true, complete, and available to everyone who needs it — engineers, manufacturing, and the regulators who will certify the vehicle. We're hiring an **Engineering Operations Lead** to build the configuration management discipline that scales with us, and to own the engineering toolchain that enforces it. You'll define and run REGENT's configuration and change management process: baselines, release workflows, the change control board, and the record of what is released and why — built for a growing engineering organization and for the regulatory path ahead. You'll own the hardware engineering toolchain — Siemens Teamcenter (with NX and Capital), and our Jira/Confluence standards — administering it, setting the rules, and keeping it a system engineers trust rather than a hurdle they route around. And you'll define how released drawings and bills of materials flow from PLM into our manufacturing execution system, so Manufacturing builds to the right revision from a single source of truth. Success looks like a Viceroy with a defensible design baseline, a change process that reaches effectivity decisions in days rather than weeks, a Teamcenter environment run as a service to the engineering team, and a shop floor that pulls from PLM. It looks like the Chief Engineer, Manufacturing, and Certification all agreeing on what "released" means — because you wrote it down and built the tools to enforce it. This is a builder's role. You'll establish the CM function at REGENT with direct partnership from the VP of Programs, the Chief Engineer, and the CTO's engineering\-lifecycle team, and shape it for the team we're becoming. If you have lived in the seam between engineering and manufacturing, if you can hold a release on procedure and then help the engineer get it through the same afternoon, and if you want to shape how a new class of vehicle gets designed, changed, and built — we want to hear from you. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * **Own configuration management for REGENT's programs.** Author and maintain the Configuration Management Plan, define HW/SW/System baselines, and act as Release Manager for the Viceroy program — the procedural authority on what is released, in\-work, or obsolete. * **Stand up and run the change process.** Write the Engineering Change Process (ECR impact assessment CCB ECO ECN), charter and run the Change Control Board across Engineering, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, and Certification, and drive effectivity decisions. * **Own the hardware engineering toolchain.** Administer Siemens Teamcenter (Active Workspace, workflows, roles, attributes, release statuses) with NX and Capital integrations; own Jama’s connection to other tools; set Jira/Confluence configuration standards; manage the engineering vendor and integrator relationships. * **Define the engineering\-to\-manufacturing data contract.** Specify which released items, attributes, and BOM structures flow from Teamcenter into the manufacturing execution system, how engineering changes propagate, and how as\-designed and as\-built are reconciled — in partnership with the MES implementation lead. * **Finish the standards Viceroy needs.** Part numbering, attribute standards, CAD and data structure, role assignments, and drawing/BOM release workflows — agreed cross\-functionally and configured in the tools before design work depends on them. * **Manage engineering licenses and tool access.** Inventory, allocation, renewals, and audit evidence for the engineering software estate. * **Prepare for configuration audits.** Build the status accounting and audit approach (FCA/PCA) that certification will require on the path from PDR to CDR and first article. **What You'll Bring** --------------------- * **Configuration management depth on hardware development programs** — identification, change control, status accounting, and audit, applied through formal design gates and into production. * **Hands\-on PLM administration**, ideally Siemens Teamcenter: item and revision lifecycles, release workflows and signatories, BOM structures, effectivity and revision rules, role\-based access, attribute and LOV configuration. Strong Windchill, 3DEXPERIENCE, or Aras experience is welcome if you've shown you can learn a second platform fast. * **Experience connecting engineering data to manufacturing** — drawing and BOM release into MES or ERP, and a clear\-eyed view of what breaks when part numbering, revisions, or ECO effectivity are wrong. * **Requirements and traceability tooling** (Jama, DOORS, or similar) and how it ties to baselines and change. * **A track record of writing process people actually follow** — plans, state diagrams, checklists — and of running a change board with senior engineers and manufacturing leads in the room. * **Credibility on both sides of the wall.** You've been trusted by engineers and by manufacturing, and you know when to hold the line and when to help. * **Comfort as the only CM person in the building**, setting priorities from program milestones and building what's missing. **Who We're Looking For** ------------------------- * **Collaborative Team Player:** You believe that great things happen when teams work together. You communicate effectively and collaborate with engineers, stakeholders, and other cross\-functional teams to align on goals and move projects forward. You bring people together, ensuring that everyone is on the same page and moving towards a shared vision. * **Creative Problem Solver**: You thrive on tackling complex challenges and finding innovative solutions. You don't just patch issues \- you improve processes, anticipate downstream impacts, and help turn one\-off fixes into scalable solutions that raise the bar for future builds. * **Adaptable \& Agile:** In a fast\-paced, ever\-evolving startup environment, you quickly adapt to changing priorities and requirements. You approach challenges with a calm, resilient mindset, and know how to pivot and adjust your approach as needed, ensuring that progress continues without missing a beat. * **Innovative Mindset**: You’re driven by curiosity and a passion for technology. You’re passionate about driving continuous improvement, embracing new technologies and methodologies to enhance efficiency, quality, and team performance. **What We Offer** ----------------- * **Competitive compensation** including a robust equity incentive plan. * Comprehensive **health, dental, and vision insurance \-** we cover **100%** of your premiums. * **401(k)** with company matching, so you can plan for the future. * Generous **flexible time off**, paid parental leave, and company\-wide holiday breaks. * **Relocation packages** available for those moving to join our team. * Daily, **free catered lunches** * Learning \& professional development opportunities **If you’re ready to take on an exciting challenge, grow with us, and make a lasting impact, we want to hear from you.** Even if you don’t meet every requirement, but you see yourself contributing to our mission, we encourage you to apply! We value diverse skillsets and experiences and believe in the potential of passionate individuals to make a big impact. **Equal Opportunity Employer** REGENT is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive work environment. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.title: Vehicle Software Engineer
jobs.description: Make it rain. Make Snow. Make Earth Habitable. Rainmaker builds and deploys audacious technologies that work with nature to create an abundant, habitable planet. We are modernizing proven cloud\-seeding science with weather\-resistant UAS, radar and satellite observations, numerical weather prediction, novel sensing and validation systems, and sustainable seeding technologies. We are building an integrated system to make more freshwater available to farms, ecosystems, and communities. Our ambition is bold, but we pursue it with humility. We take on difficult problems in the real world with technical rigor, grit, integrity, and an openness to learning and course\-correcting. We are hiring individuals with evidence of exceptional ability. If you want to build systems that endure, restore, and deliver the future we were promised, we want to hear from you. The vehicle software team builds the software that operates Rainmaker’s cloud\-seeding vehicles, connecting flight control, onboard computing, sensors, payloads, and ground operations. We work closely with electrical, mechanical, manufacturing, and flight operations teams to turn new hardware into reliable systems that can be built, deployed, and operated at scale. Our goal is to make every vehicle a dependable tool for delivering more freshwater where it is needed. ### **About the Role** You will own vehicle software capabilities from the operator interface to the onboard systems that execute a mission. Your work will span ground stations, mission planning and execution, failsafe behaviors, sensing, payload and sensor integration, and autonomy. You will build software that helps operators make good decisions, lets vehicles carry out missions reliably, and handles failures predictably. You will take projects from architecture and prototyping through simulation, hardware integration, flight testing, deployment, and field support. We’re looking for a high\-agency engineer who identifies what needs to happen, turns incomplete requirements into a clear plan, and follows through until the system works reliably in real operating conditions. This is a hands\-on technical ownership role with the autonomy to shape the vehicle software and the responsibility to deliver it.### **What You'll Do** * Own the architecture, implementation, and maintenance of vehicle software capabilities across onboard computers and ground systems, with clear contracts for commands, telemetry, state, and failure behavior. * Build operator interfaces and ground\-station workflows for vehicle preparation, preflight checks, mission control, health monitoring, and intervention. Make vehicle state, command outcomes, and required operator actions clear. * Develop mission planning and execution software that turns operational goals into validated flight paths and geofences, accounts for vehicle endurance, coordinates flight and seeding activity, and supports mission changes as conditions evolve. * Design and validate arming checks, interlocks, and failsafe behaviors for communication loss, degraded sensing, low power, process failures, and unexpected vehicle states, including clear transitions between autonomous behavior and operator control. * Integrate sensors, cameras, and seeding payloads with onboard software and flight\-control systems. Ensure measurements, calibration, timestamps, device health, and payload commands are reliable and observable. * Develop autonomy that uses sensing and vehicle state to execute missions within operating limits, handle contingencies, and reduce operator workload. * Build dependable communication between vehicles and ground stations, accounting for intermittent links, stale telemetry, and commands that may be delayed, duplicated, or unacknowledged. * Build automated tests, software\-in\-the\-loop simulation, and hardware\-in\-the\-loop coverage that catch regressions and exercise failure modes before releases reach the fleet. * Partner with hardware engineers and flight operations to validate new capabilities on the bench and in flight, and make deployment, configuration, calibration, and diagnostics repeatable. * Investigate field failures using logs, telemetry, and mission replay; resolve root causes and turn what you learn into better software, tests, and operator workflows. ### **What We're Looking For** * 3\+ years of hands\-on experience developing software for vehicles, robotics, or other systems that interact with the physical world, including deployment into production or field use. * Demonstrated ownership of a software capability from design through integration, release, and ongoing support, including making technical decisions independently and resolving failures in real operating conditions. * Strong systems programming skills in Rust or C/C\+\+, with the willingness to work primarily in Rust and contribute to TypeScript\-based operator interfaces. Our stack includes Rust onboard services and ground\-station backends, React/TypeScript interfaces in Electron, and PX4 flight\-control integration over MAVLink. * Experience developing and debugging software on Linux, including concurrent processes, network communication, and interfaces to hardware or flight\-control systems. * Practical experience in one or more of the following: operator interfaces and ground stations, mission planning, autonomy, sensing, or payload integration, with the willingness to work across these boundaries. * The ability to reason about distributed system state, timing, and failures, and implement robust state machines, fault detection, failsafes, and recovery paths. * A practical approach to operator\-facing software: you can turn field workflows into clear controls, useful feedback, and predictable system behavior. * Experience building maintainable software with version control, reproducible builds, automated testing, and disciplined release practices. * Evidence of high agency: you surface problems without waiting to be assigned, make sound decisions with incomplete information, ask for help when it matters, and close the loop on results. * Clear communication and the ability to work closely with hardware engineers and operators, explain tradeoffs, and document decisions so others can operate and support what you ship. ### **What Will Set Your Apart** * Experience deploying drones or autonomous robots and supporting real\-world flight or field operations. * Familiarity with PX4, MAVLink, ground\-control systems, or flight\-critical software. * Experience building operator interfaces with React, TypeScript, or Electron, particularly mapping tools or geospatial mission\-planning workflows. * Experience with sensor fusion, state estimation, path planning, or autonomous mission execution. * Experience integrating payloads, sensors, or embedded controllers over interfaces such as CAN, serial, or Ethernet. * Experience validating safety\-related behaviors through simulation, hardware\-in\-the\-loop testing, fault injection, and field testing. ### **What Success Looks Like In the First 90 Days** You understand how operators plan and execute missions and can trace commands, telemetry, and failure behavior between the ground station, onboard software, flight controller, sensors, and payloads. You have identified the most consequential reliability risks and operator pain points, and the team has a clear plan for what to address first. You have delivered a meaningful vehicle software improvement through simulation and integration testing into an operational release, working with flight operations to verify its behavior in the field. You have demonstrated both its intended behavior and its response to relevant failures, and improved at least one recurring source of friction in mission planning, operation, testing, deployment, or diagnostics. **Supporting the people behind the mission** Making Earth more habitable is ambitious work. jobs.title: Staff Software Test Engineer
jobs.description: **Description** **Staff SDET — Consumer Quality Enablement** Recognized as the No. 1 site trusted by real estate professionals, Realtor.com® has been at the forefront of online real estate for over 25 years, connecting buyers, sellers, and renters with trusted insights and expert guidance to find their perfect home. Through its robust suite of tools, Realtor.com® not only makes a significant impact on the real estate industry at large, but for consumers, navigating the biggest purchase they will make in their life, by providing a user experience that is easy to use, easy to understand, and most of all, easy to make decisions. Join us on our mission to empower more people to find their way home by breaking barriers to entry, making the right connections, and building confidence through expert guidance. **About the Role** We have an exciting opportunity for an innovative Staff Engineer in Test to join our RDC team. The charter for this team is to build and deliver innovative solutions across the real\-estate ecosystem that deepen relationships with industry players, consumers, and brokers/agents. This role is part of Quality Enablement team. Consumer Quality Enablement is a platform team — not embedded in any single product squad but responsible for the quality infrastructure that serves the entire Consumer Engineering organization: 30\+ scrum teams, 400\+ repositories, and five surfaces (Web, iOS, Android, Backend Services). We operate as Quality\-as\-a\-Service. Our job is to build systems, frameworks, and tooling that make it easier for product engineers to ship with confidence — without requiring a dedicated QA resource on every team. We govern, audit , create paved path and enable engineers with tools , process, framework , reporting and governance **What You'll Do** As a Staff SDET on Consumer Quality Enablement, you are the technical backbone of how we build, evolve, and enforce quality infrastructure at scale. You own the design and delivery of the test frameworks, AI\-powered tooling, and quality\-gate systems that the broader engineering org depends on. This is a senior individual contributor role. You will not manage people directly, but you will set technical direction, establish standards, and pull other engineers — inside and outside the team — toward higher\-quality practices. **What You'll Own** **AI\-Powered Quality Tooling** * Evolve the Genesis AI test\-case generation platform — coverage expansion, prompt engineering, model selection, accuracy measurement. * Build and maintain the AI RCA (Root Cause Analysis) pipeline that surfaces incident and test\-failure context automatically. * Develop the Test Fix Agent: automated triage, flakiness detection, and patch suggestion for failing tests in CI. * Define the evaluation harness and quality metrics for all AI tooling — precision, recall, engineer adoption. **Test Framework Infrastructure (Paved Path)** * Own the "Paved Path" for Web (Playwright\-based) and Mobile (Appium/iOS XCUITest/Android Espresso) — the opinionated, zero\-config test setup that product teams clone to get started. Define the layered testing contract: unit integration* E2E thresholds per surface. * Build and maintain shared test utilities, fixtures, data factories, and environment\-management tooling. * Integrate with CI/CD pipelines (CircleCI) so quality gates run reliably on every PR with no manual setup from product teams. **Quality Gate Enforcement Platform** * Design and operate the quality\-gate system: code coverage gates, PR review gates, build stability gates. * Build enforcement tooling that moves gates from advisory to blocking — with clear escalation paths and override controls that don't silently waive standards. * Instrument and surface gate compliance metrics (repos gated, gate\-fail\-merge rate, PR coverage trends) so engineering leadership has a live quality signal. * Drive SonarCloud configuration hygiene: quality profiles, branch rules, coverage ingestion, and gate\-scoring across all 100\+ repositories. **Quality Observability** * Define and own the quality metrics taxonomy: escape rate, main\-branch stability, attestable coverage (vs. reported), review depth, incident detection ratio. * Build dashboards and alerting so EMs and leads get a team\-level quality picture without manual data collection. Partner with the incident management process to close the loop from production incident root cause coverage gap* remediated test. **Technical Leadership** * Author and maintain the quality engineering standards playbook for Consumer Engineering. * Run architecture reviews for test infrastructure decisions in product squads. * Mentor senior STEs and SWEs on test design, framework usage, and quality patterns. * Represent Consumer Quality Enablement in cross\-functional engineering forums (release, platform, architecture). **What We're Looking For** * 8\+ years of software development or SDET experience with at least 3 years at staff/senior staff scope. * Production\-quality engineering skills: you write code that ships to a shared platform, not scripts that live in a test folder. * Deep experience with at least two of: Playwright/WebdriverIO, XCUITest, Espresso — and a clear framework philosophy, not just syntax familiarity. * Experience designing test frameworks from the ground up — including fixture management, test data strategy, environment isolation, and parallelization. * Working knowledge of CI/CD systems (CircleCI, GitHub Actions, or equivalent) and how quality gates integrate into merge workflows. * Familiarity with AWS services used in CI/CD and data pipelines (Lambda, S3, Bedrock) — enough to own the infrastructure your tooling runs on. * Experience with contract testing (Pact or equivalent) and API\-level quality tooling for microservice or GraphQL architectures. * Hands\-on experience building and evaluating LLM\-powered applications, including eval harness design, production model integration, test\-generation quality measurement, and regression prevention across model upgrades. * Strong software engineering fundamentals: system design, API design, code review, observability, and reliability for internal platforms. * Ability to influence without authority at scale — your platform serves hundreds of engineers; you write docs, run office hours, and make it easy to do the right thing. * Experience in a platform/enablement team that served multiple product squads. * Familiarity with SonarCloud, Xray, or other quality gate and test management tooling. * Python and TypeScript fluency (our AI tooling stack and web test stack respectively). * Prior work building quality metrics systems — escape rate, flakiness rates, coverage trends — not just dashboards but the data pipelines behind them. * Mobile app testing experience across both iOS and Android platforms * Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience. **Nice to Have** * Prior experience in Performance testing for Native apps * Performance and Load testing basic understanding **Success in this Role** Success here is not measured by test count or coverage percentage alone. It is measured by whether the engineering organization ships with more confidence. The challenge isn't finding bugs; it's building systems that catch the right bugs at the right time automatically. * You think at the system level, not the ticket level. * You don't need to be an expert in all of it — but you need to be genuinely curious about all of it. * You are as comfortable in a data pipeline as you are in a test framework. * You solve problems top\-down. * You are a force multiplier, not a ticket\-taker. * You are comfortable with ambiguity and willing to get your hands dirty. * You learn fast, form hypotheses, ship something small, and iterate. * You are the kind of engineer who makes the team around you better. * You give direct technical feedback. You write things down. * You make it easy for product engineers to do the right thing without asking. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

You will write production C\# and SQL, and you will build the services, instrumentation, evaluation harnesses, and data pipelines that turn an Applied Science approach into something customers can rely on, and diagnose what goes wrong when they can't. You will build and operate the AI systems behind Relativity aiR at production scale, under real legal stakes. You will work side by side with Applied Scientists, who own the science, and with Product, who owns the value case, so that what we ship meets the reliability target it was promised at. Along the way you will work with multiple databases, processing and web servers, search engines, and clustering technologies, using many of the newer and stronger technologies available. principles and design patterns in multiple languages. * **Agile Delivery.** Participate in our SCRUM process and deliver through CI/CD with strong observability. * **Performance.** Improve application and system performance at scale. * **Quality and Support.** Troubleshoot issues by fixing defects and responding to client\-specific problems. **AI engineering** * **Prototype to Production.** latency, and cost, and build dashboards and alerts against the reliability target. * **Diagnose.** Diagnose and mitigate common failure modes, including drift, latency regressions, cost blow\-ups, tool\-call and retrieval errors, and data\-quality effects on outputs. * **Evaluation Harness.** Build and maintain the evaluation harness and regression checks that gate releases, and extend coverage as use cases grow. * **Component Design.** Design components of an AI solution with senior review, document interfaces and non\-functional requirements, and apply patterns proven elsewhere in the company. * **Data Pipelines.** Build and operate the pipelines for a feature with reproducibility, lineage, and automated data\-quality monitoring. * **Trade\-offs.** Make and document implementation trade\-offs (batching, caching, model tier, timeouts, fallbacks) with sound reasoning about quality and cost. * **Security and Compliance.** Work with Relativity's security team to protect customer data and meet compliance requirements in every AI feature you build. * **AI\-Assisted Development.** Use modern AI coding tools in your daily work to raise the speed and quality of design, development, testing, and code review, and share what works with the team. **Collaboration and growth** * **Prioritize.** Prioritize independently acr ties, and future directions. **Required Qualifications** * **3\+ years** of professional software development experience using **C\#** and **Microsoft SQL Server** , or related object\-oriented languages. * Experience building web applications with **JavaScript** and **ASP.NET** . * Experience building scalable solutions on **Azure** or another cloud platform. * Experience working on an agile software development team. * Experience with **CI/CD** and an understanding of DevOps principles. * **1\+ year** building or operating AI/ML systems or their data pipelines, such as LLM integrations, prompt design, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), or embeddings. * Experience deploying and monitoring models or LLM\-based services in a cloud environment. * Practical ML fluency: you can read evaluation results, reason about model failure modes, and make quality, latency, and cost trade\-offs. * Experience building data pipelines with orchestration tooling (such as Prefect or Airflow) and attention to reproducibility. * Working knowledge of **Python** alongside C\#. * Regular use of AI\-assisted development tools, with sound judgment about when to trust and when to verify their output. * Ability to design and document a component of a larger system, including non\-functional requirements. Effective collaboration with scientists, engineers, and product partners. * **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience building evaluation harnesses or regression suites for AI systems, including evaluating LLM output quality. * Experience with LLM orchestration or agent frameworks, agentic workflows, and tool calling. * Experience with large\-scale or sensitive data. * Experience with **Azure DevOps** and Azure AI and data services. * Experience with **Docker** , **Kubernetes** , and **Helm** . * Experience with infrastructure as code (for example Terraform, Pulumi, AWS CDK, or CloudFormation). * Experience with MLflow or Kubeflow, or with big data frameworks such as Apache Spark or Kafka. * Experience building or deploying models with frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or Keras, or depth in an area such as NLP. Bachelor's or advanced degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or Artificial Intelligence. * **Why We Could Be a Great Fit** * **Impactful Mission.** Organize Data, Discover the Truth and Act on It. Our customers include Fortune 500 enterprises and leading law firms managing high\-stakes matters on our platform. * **Growth Path.** Engineers gain exposure across the stack, from distributed systems to AI\-enabled workflows, which accelerates career growth. * **Engineering Culture.** Continuous delivery, strong observability, and end\-to\-end ownership. * **Inclusive Environment.** Diverse backgrounds and perspectives make us stronger. * **Community Impact.** Volunteer opportunities and company\-sponsored charitable programs. * **Compensation and Benefits.** Competitive salary, health and retirement programs, wellness resources, discretionary time off (DTO), parental leave for primary and secondary caregivers, two annual company breaks, a home office stipend, and an equity program. **Relativity is committed to competitive, fair, and equitable compensation practices.** This position is eligible for total compensation which includes a competitive base salary, an annual performance bonus, and long\-term incentives. jobs.title: Senior Inference Optimization ML Engineer
jobs.description: At Rhoda AI, we’re building the next generation of generalist intelligent robots. We own the full robotics stack from high\-performance hardware and robot systems to the infrastructure and state\-of\-the\-art foundation world models that control our robots. Our robots are designed to be generalists capable of operating in complex, real\-world environments and handling long\-tail edge cases, made possible by our cutting edge research and end\-to\-end system design. We've raised over $450M and are investing aggressively in model research, infrastructure, hardware development, and manufacturing scale\-up to make generalist robotics a reality. Running large multimodal foundation models for a growing fleet of robots is expensive. We can't rely on one hardware vendor or the most expensive accelerators. We're looking for an Inference Optimization engineer to make Rhoda's models run fast, correctly, and cheaply on a wide range of hardware: AMD Instinct GPUs, Google TPUs, wafer\-scale and dataflow accelerators, consumer GPUs like the RTX 5090, and the Jetson/Thor\-class compute on our robots. You'll decide which chip runs which workload, and then make sure it runs well there. You'll work closely with the research, robotics, and infrastructure teams. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * **Own cost\-efficient inference end\-to\-end.** Make Rhoda's foundation models (vision, video, language, proprioception, action) faster and cheaper to run, measured in latency, throughput, and cost per inference. * **Port and optimize models for non\-NVIDIA and lower\-cost hardware.** This includes AMD (ROCm, HIP, MIOpen/hipBLASLt, Composable Kernel), TPU (XLA, JAX, Pallas, PyTorch/XLA), wafer\-scale and dataflow accelerators (their SDKs and compilers), and consumer Blackwell GPUs such as the RTX 5090 (FP8/FP4, small memory, multi\-GPU setups over PCIe). * **Own on\-robot inference.** Deploy and optimize models on Jetson/Thor\-class embedded compute under tight latency, power, thermal, and memory limits, and decide how work is split between the robot and the cloud to meet real\-time control requirements. * **Evaluate hardware rigorously.** Build cost/performance models (perf/$, perf/W, memory capacity and bandwidth, interconnect) for each chip and model family. Write clear recommendations on which hardware to buy or rent for serving, offline evaluation, and on\-robot use. * **Build hardware\-portable optimizations.** Write and tune kernels that work across vendors where possible (Triton, Pallas, MLIR\-based compilers) and vendor\-specific ones where the speedup justifies it. Handle attention, KV cache, memory layout, and fused operators on every backend. * **Apply model compression for constrained hardware.** Use quantization (INT8, FP8, FP4/MX formats, AWQ/GPTQ), pruning, distillation, and model or tensor parallelism so models fit and perform well on chips with less memory or limited data\-type support. * **Keep results correct and consistent across backends.** Build tests that check numerical parity, policy quality, and robot\-relevant behaviour, so a model gives the same results whichever chip it runs on. * **Build benchmarking and regression infrastructure across hardware.** Track latency baselines, throughput curves, and cost per inference for every model version on every target, with automated detection of regressions. * **Work with research engineers** to design models that stay efficient and portable from the start, for example by avoiding operators that only exist on one vendor's hardware. **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- * 2\+ years of experience in inference optimization, ML systems, ML compilers, or a closely related field. * Deep hands\-on experience with PyTorch. * Strong understanding of compute, memory bandwidth, memory capacity, and interconnect bottlenecks, and how they change from one hardware architecture to another. * Experience with model optimization techniques: quantization (INT8/FP8/FP4, AWQ), distillation, pruning, and compilation (torch.compile, XLA, TensorRT, IREE/MLIR, TVM, or vendor compilers). * Familiarity with inference serving frameworks and their support for different hardware (e.g. vLLM on ROCm/TPU, SGLang, JetStream, Triton Inference Server). * Excellent debugging and measurement skills. You can take "this is slow on chip X" or "this costs too much" and turn it into clear bottlenecks, experiments, and validated improvements. * A high\-ownership, pragmatic mindset. You care about the total cost of a solution, not just peak benchmark numbers. **Nice to Have (But Not Required)** ----------------------------------- * Experience optimizing inference for diffusion models. * Production or deep project experience with **at least one accelerator stack other than NVIDIA datacenter GPUs**: AMD ROCm, Google TPU, wafer\-scale and dataflow accelerators, Groq, Tenstorrent, AWS Trainium/Inferentia, Intel Gaudi, or similar, or serious work deploying on consumer GPUs. * Kernel authoring on more than one backend: HIP or Composable Kernel on AMD, Pallas on TPU, Triton on both NVIDIA and AMD, CUTLASS/CuTe. * Contributions to open\-source ML compilers or hardware backends (PyTorch, OpenXLA, Triton, vLLM, IREE, TVM). * Experience running inference on wafer\-scale systems, TPU pods, or fleets of consumer GPUs. * Hands\-on experience with Jetson/Thor\-class platforms (TensorRT on Jetson, JetPack, DLA, power and thermal profiling). * Experience with multimodal or video model inference (variable\-length sequences, packing/bucketing). * Speculative decoding, continuous batching, disaggregated prefill/decode, or other LLM serving optimizations. * Experience with streaming or low\-latency systems for real\-time robot control. * Experience working with hardware vendors on driver or compiler bugs and early\-access silicon. **Why This Role** ----------------- * **Direct impact on cost and scale.** Every gain in perf/$ you deliver lowers the cost of serving models and evaluating new ones, and of putting capable models on many more robots. * **Strategic influence over hardware.** Your benchmarks and recommendations will directly shape which accelerators Rhoda buys and builds on, in the cloud and on the robot. * **High ownership on a small, elite team.** You'll own the optimization layer that decides how fast and how cheaply our foundation models run in the real world, on every target we use.

support egress proxy platform onboarding and phased policy enforcement. * **Serve as the senior technical authority for GCP networking** across engineering and operations — troubleshooting complex network failures across hybrid environments, participating in on\-call rotation, delivering approved changes within maintenance windows, and identifying continuous improvement opportunities to reduce risk, optimise capacity, and elevate engineering standards. **What We’re Looking For:** **Basic Required Qualifications:** * Proven experience (10\+ years) in enterprise networking, including significant hands\-on experience in large\-scale cloud environments. * Hands\-on experience designing, deploying and operating Palo Alto Networks firewalls, including VM\-Series in cloud and centralized management via Panorama. * Deep, hands\-on GCP networking experience, including VPC and Shared VPC design, Cloud Interconnect, Cloud Router, Cloud NAT, Cloud DNS, Cloud Load Balancing and Private Service Connect. * Demonstrable production experience with network automation and infrastructure\-as\-code, including Terraform and Python, with version control using Git. * Excellent knowledge of networking standards, protocols and technologies, including BGP, OSPF, routing policy, switching, VPNs, DNS and load balancing. * Working knowledge of AWS and Azure networking, including Direct Connect, Transit Gateway, VPC and security groups, ExpressRoute and Virtual WAN. * Excellent troubleshooting and analytical skills to diagnose and resolve complex network issues across cloud and hybrid environments. * Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with cross\-functional teams. * Team player who enjoys a mix of autonomy and collaboration\-based delivery. * Ability to manage multiple priorities, commitments and projects. * Bachelor's degree  strong worldwide—so we're able to understand nuances while having a broad perspective. jobs.description: **Ready to be a Titan?** ServiceTitan is building the Developer Platform for enterprise\-scale SaaS. DevEx is a newly formed, lean, highly agile team (3–4 people) building AI\-enabled platform infrastructure — pioneering AI\-assisted development tools and coding agent runtimes (like Codex) to help engineering teams operate at “AI speed.” This is a Staff Software Engineer role per ServiceTitan's engineering leveling framework: 10\+ years of experience, Advanced Engineer level, working across squad(s)\-scale, large or potentially distributed systems. **What You'll Build** * **AI\-Native Tooling**: Components of the agent orchestration layer and harness that let coding agents operate reliably inside ServiceTitan's systems. * **Environments**: CDEs, on\-demand provisioning, mocking, and data seeding. * **Build \& CI/CD:** Build parallelization, remote caching, test\-splitting, secure and progressive rollout pipelines. * **Developer Portal:** Golden Paths, scaffolding, and service/API catalogs. * **Guardrails \& Compliance:** Automated linting, security scanning, and policy\-as\-code embedded in workflows. **What You'll Do** * **Nature of Work:** Make core architectural decisions and design systems within your area; lead investigations and guide deep\-level refactoring; demonstrate knowledge across multiple domains (agent runtimes, build infra, environments) and know how to glue distributed systems together. * **Delivery:** Write code and set the standard others emulate — full rigor on testing for scale, resiliency, performance, and security. Roadmap large tracks of work with reliable estimates and help the team hit its commitments. * **Independence \& Decision Making:** Make technical decisions across a large area of the platform and resolve in\-depth needs without needing to be told how. * **Ownership:** Be the go\-to SME for at least one major piece of the DevEx platform (e.g., the agent harness, or the CDE provisioning layer) — recognized by the team as the person who owns it. * **Leadership:** Mentor engineers in technical design and architecture; participate in interviewing and hiring recommendations for the team. * Partner with the Principal Engineer/EM to turn multi\-quarter strategy into sequenced, shippable slices of infrastructure. **What You'll Bring** * 10\+ years of software engineering experience, with recent (last 6–12 months) hands\-on platform or DevX work. * Direct, hands\-on experience with AI/agent tooling beyond process automation or code\-review assistance — this is the line that separates a real Staff\-level DevEx candidate from a strong platform generalist. Concretely, we're looking for: a primary dev environment built around a coding\-agent app (e.g., Codex, Claude Code) that you run on both desktop and mobile, agent sessions you keep running continuously rather than one\-off, and the ability to speak in depth about orchestrating more than one agent against real work — not just occasional prompt engineering or asking an agent to draft a spec from a brief. * Experience shipping CI/CD pipelines, build systems, internal developer portals, or test automation platforms in production, at a scope consistent with “large, potentially distributed systems.” * Practical fluency with containerization/orchestration (Kubernetes/Docker) and cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP). * Comfort operating independently on a small team — you're expected to see and plan around disruptions, not just react to them. **Preferred Experience** * Some direct exposure to coding\-agent\-runtime work, even partial — the strongest differentiator against other Staff\-level platform candidates. * Experience where AI\-agent adoption was a team or org push you helped drive, not just something you did solo — and where the work is current (roughly the last 3 months), not a project you haven't touched in over a year. * Experience with compliance\-sensitive workflows, change management systems, or policy engines. **Be Human With Us:** Being human isn’t about checking every box on a list. It’s about the experiences we have, people we meet, and the perspectives we share. So, if you have the skills but are hesitant to apply because of your background, apply anyway. AI tools are not used to make hiring decisions; all hiring decisions are made by our hiring teams. **What We Offer:** When you join our team, you’re not just accepting a job. You’re making a career move. complex payment systems into production. * Deep expertise with Stripe APIs, Stripe Billing, Stripe Connect, webhooks, and payout workflows. * Experience integrating bank payment rails, including ACH and third\-party banking/payment providers. * Strong backend expertise in Node.js/TypeScript, Python, Go, or comparable production technologies. * Strong frontend experience with React, Next.js, or comparable frameworks. * Expertise in PostgreSQL, transactional databases, financial ledgers, and distributed systems. * Proven experience designing secure, reliable, auditable financial transaction workflows. * Ability to independently translate business requirements into architecture and working production software. **Strongly Preferred** * Experience building affiliate commissions, performance incentive engines, marketplace payments, or rewards platforms. * Experience with earned\-value systems, internal tokens, digital wallets, and conversion\-to\-cash workflows. * Familiarity with KYC/KYB, AML, sanctions screening, 1099 reporting, and payout compliance. * Experience designing systems with Stripe Connect and multiple financial service providers. * Previous experience as a founding engineer, principal engineer, or payments architect at a fintech, marketplace, or SaaS company. **Why This Role Is Urgent** * Launch is weeks away, and member billing has to work on day one. jobs.description: About the Role We are seeking a skilled **Clinical Engineering Cybersecurity Specialist** to support the medical device cybersecurity program in Far Rockaway, NY. The ideal candidate will have **hands\-on experience working with medical equipment or medical devices**, combined with knowledge or practical exposure to cybersecurity. This role is suited to a biomedical engineer, biomedical equipment technician (BMET), clinical engineer, or healthcare technology professional who understands medical device operations and can help protect connected medical equipment from cybersecurity threats. You will work closely with hospital IT, Information Security, Healthcare Technology Management (HTM) teams, and medical device manufacturers to identify security risks, implement cybersecurity controls, and maintain the safety, security, and availability of medical devices. Key Responsibilities Medical Device Cybersecurity \& Technical Support * Support the implementation and ongoing management of medical device cybersecurity strategies. * Collect critical cybersecurity data elements (CDEs) and manufacturer documentation for medical devices within the CMMS and asset inventory. * Conduct cybersecurity risk assessments based on collected device information and manufacturer recommendations. * Oversee medical device configurations to ensure alignment with cybersecurity standards and manufacturer guidelines. * Coordinate planned vulnerability remediation, including software patching, upgrades, and security updates. * Support unplanned vulnerability remediation, including assessment and response to zero\-day threats. * Coordinate cybersecurity activities and remediation efforts with medical device manufacturers. * Test and validate network segmentation rules in collaboration with hospital IT teams. * Support IT projects that may affect medical devices connected to the hospital network. Vulnerability Management \& Program Support * Investigate cybersecurity alerts involving medical devices across the hospital and clinics. * Analyze high\-risk and critical vulnerabilities and develop appropriate response recommendations. * Track, document, and report vulnerability remediation activities. * Identify opportunities to improve cybersecurity practices across HTM and IT teams. * Maintain the accuracy and quality of cybersecurity data and documentation in the CMMS. Training \& Collaboration * Support cybersecurity education and awareness initiatives for HTM teams. * Coach Biomedical Equipment Technicians (BMETs) on basic cybersecurity hygiene and device security controls. * Collaborate with hospital IT, InfoSec, clinical engineering, and equipment manufacturers. * Participate in relevant industry cybersecurity workgroups and forums. * Complete required technical and non\-technical training. Regulatory \& Compliance * Support hospital cybersecurity audits involving HIPAA and Joint Commission requirements. * Provide technical guidance during enterprise cybersecurity audits. * Help ensure medical device cybersecurity practices align with applicable regulatory and organizational requirements. Required Qualifications * Bachelor's degree in Biomedical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field; equivalent experience may be considered. * Minimum of **3 years of relevant functional experience with Biomedical devices**. * Hands\-on experience working with medical devices, biomedical equipment, clinical engineering, or healthcare technology environments. * Knowledge or practical exposure to cybersecurity concepts, preferably involving medical devices or healthcare environments. * Understanding of medical equipment troubleshooting, configuration, maintenance, or technical support. * Knowledge of cybersecurity frameworks such as NIST and ISO. * Familiarity with CMMS platforms and medical equipment asset management. * Understanding of vulnerability management, risk assessments, security patching, and remediation. * Knowledge of FDA and Joint Commission requirements relevant to medical devices and healthcare environments. * Valid driver's license and acceptable driving record. * Strong communication, problem\-solving, documentation, and cross\-functional collaboration skills. Preferred Qualifications * Direct experience with medical device cybersecurity. * Experience working with hospital IT, Information Security, or Healthcare Technology Management teams. * Experience coordinating firmware updates, software upgrades, security patches, or vulnerability remediation for medical equipment. * Familiarity with medical device networking and network segmentation. * Relevant certifications such as CompTIA Security\+, CEH, CISSP, or HCISPP. * Experience with cybersecurity risk assessments and manufacturer security documentation.
