jobs.title: Service Innovation & Development Engineer
jobs.description: **The Company:** Sungrow North America is a leading provider of renewable energy solutions, specializing in the development and manufacturing of photovoltaic inverters and energy storage systems. The company offers a comprehensive range of products and services designed to optimize the performance and efficiency of solar power installations. Sungrow North America aims to provide sustainable and reliable energy solutions to meet the growing demand for clean power and is known for its commitment to innovation, high\-quality standards, and exceptional customer service. **The Position:** The Service Innovation \& Development Engineer is a hybrid position based in the Sungrow Houston, TX office, reporting to the Service AI Agent product owner within the Strategic Expert team. The Service Innovation \& Development Engineer is an intelligent agent with Sungrow domain knowledge, deployed in Sungrow's company business software platforms including Microsoft Teams. Today it tracks and escalates unanswered field requests, answers technical questions from archived Q\&A, and identifies spare parts from photos using OCR, image embeddings, catalog retrieval and LLM\-based evidence checking. The developer owns the codebase end to end (design, implementation, deployment and operation) and leads the next wave of integrations with Sungrow business systems. This is a hands\-on role on a small team, working directly with the field service engineers who use the tool every day. **Essential Duties and Responsibilities:** * Design, implement, test and ship features for the Service AI Agent (Node.js/TypeScript, Microsoft Teams SDK, Azure Bot Framework) across the full stack: Teams ingress, request lifecycle, background workers, retrieval and data layer. * Own the production stack: PostgreSQL schema and knex migrations (pgvector, pg\_trgm), the Python SigLIP image\-encoder worker, public ingress (Cloudflare tunnel today, Azure App Service as the target), and the deployment runbooks. * Extend the spare\-parts identification pipeline: OCR of board labels and barcodes, hybrid retrieval (identifier, text\-embedding and image\-similarity), LLM evidence comparison, company part\-number validation and the human confirmation and learning loop. * Build integrations with Sungrow business systems: PLM 3DEXPERIENCE (parts and BOM), iQMS (serial\-number trace and as\-built records), SharePoint via Microsoft Graph, and the Airtable spare\-parts inventory; later, controlled write\-back for ordering and repair workflows. * Deliver structural\-part PDF drawing matching and BOM linkage, the next planned work package. * Build the real\-data evaluation harness: expert\-labelled test sets, regression suites, accuracy and latency comparisons; use the results to adapt OCR and retrieval models. * Operate the service: monitoring and Application Insights telemetry, incident response, catalog and data refreshes, and permission hygiene (Teams RSC scopes, Graph app roles, Key Vault secrets). * Manage LLM and embedding usage (OpenAI API): prompt and model\-version changes, cost and latency tracking, content\-minimization and data\-handling rules. * Write and maintain design documents, deployment runbooks and user guides for field engineers. * Coordinate with Sungrow HQ R\&D and IT in China on API access, authorization and data sources. * Set coding standards, CI and the release process; review and mentor the part\-time developer on the team. * Gather feedback from field service engineers and the Strategic Expert team, prioritize the backlog with the product owner, and deliver in staged rollouts. * Other duties as assigned. **Minimum Requirements:** * Bachelor's degree or above in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical/Computer Engineering, or equivalent experience. * Microsoft Azure certifications (AZ\-204 Developer, AI\-102 AI Engineer) desired but not required. * Solar, battery, power\-electronics or industrial\-service domain experience desired. * 3 plus years of professional software development, including 2 plus years with Node.js/TypeScript in production. * Experience building bots or integrations on Microsoft Teams and Azure Bot Framework (or a comparable messaging platform), and with Microsoft Graph and Entra ID app registrations. * Strong SQL and PostgreSQL: schema design, migrations (knex or similar) and query tuning; vector search (pgvector) a plus. * Hands\-on experience with LLM APIs (OpenAI or similar): prompt design, structured outputs, embeddings, retrieval\-augmented generation and evaluation. * Working Python for ML inference services (PyTorch, transformers, image preprocessing), enough to maintain and extend the SigLIP encoder worker. * REST API design and integration, OAuth2 and token handling, retries and error handling. * Git, automated tests (vitest or similar), CI, Docker, and Linux/macOS server operation. * Must possess effective written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work with field engineers and non\-technical stakeholders. * English Language Proficiency required. * Mandarin Chinese Proficiency desired but not required (coordination with HQ R\&D). **Travel:** * Up to 10% (Sungrow service and training centers and customer sites for user feedback and field testing). **Work Location and Status:** * Contract role based out of Houston, TX. * No visa/legal sponsorship. **Compensation:** * Compensation commensurate with experience * Competitive benefits package and employee programs * Strong personal and company growth opportunities *For candidates in the states of California, Colorado, New York and Washington, the anticipated annual base salary for this role is between $75,000 \- $105,000 This range does not include any other compensation components or other benefits that an individual may be eligible for. The base salary offered is dependent upon several factors, including but not limited to job\-related skills, qualifications, experience, education, location, or other factors related to the role.* ***Sungrow is an equal opportunity employer. Due to strong interest in this role, Sungrow will only reach out to those candidates who best meet the requirements of the position. Thank you for your interest in Sungrow.*** \#LI\-LV1

jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description: **About Us** ------------ At Thesis, we believe everyone should have the opportunity to meet their potential. We build nootropic supplements and customer experiences that help people find the right support for their goals. Across Thesis and Stasis, we're also changing how our company works. Our teams use AI to develop creative, research customers, build digital experiences, analyze performance, and reduce repetitive operational work. We're looking for an engineer who can turn those experiments into reliable systems that people use every day. **About the Role** ------------------ We're looking for an AI Engineer to build the agents, integrations, and internal tools that help a small team accomplish more. You'll work with Data, Engineering, Growth, Creative, and Operations to find valuable problems, prototype solutions, and own them through deployment, adoption, and ongoing improvement. This is a hands\-on software engineering role focused on applied AI. You'll build with existing models, connect them to our tools and knowledge, and make their outputs useful and trustworthy. You should be as comfortable debugging an API integration as designing an agent workflow, and care about whether your work saves time, improves decisions, or helps the business grow. We already have AI\-assisted workflows and a shared Claude skill and knowledge system. You'll build on that foundation, making successful workflows easier to reuse and bringing production engineering to the parts that need it. You won't be starting from a blank page, and you won't be limited to maintaining what's already there. **How You'll Make an Impact** ----------------------------- ### **Build agents that do useful work** * Design and ship agents that retrieve information, use tools, and complete multi\-step tasks across our business systems. * Connect workflows across tools such as Slack, Google Workspace, Asana, Shopify, and Klaviyo through APIs, webhooks, and MCP integrations. * Make long\-running workflows dependable with persistent state, retries, duplicate prevention, clear approvals, and recoverable failures. ### **Accelerate creative and growth workflows** * Partner with Creative and Growth to improve the path from customer research and performance insights to briefs, scripts, creative variants, and testable landing pages. * Build workflows that combine brand knowledge, approved product claims, asset libraries, and creative performance data while keeping human review where it matters. * Help teams learn from prior experiments so each new brief or test benefits from what we've already discovered. ### **Make company knowledge and data more useful** * Extend our shared skills, knowledge base, retrieval, and context\-management systems so AI tools can find and use the right source material. * Partner with our data team to connect AI workflows to governed analytics in Metabase and Hex, backed by Snowflake, rather than inventing competing definitions of business metrics. * Use SQL and data validation to investigate issues, verify outputs, and make analytical workflows easier for non\-technical teammates to use. ### **Turn prototypes into reliable products** * Build evaluations using real business tasks. Test accuracy, task completion, tool behavior, failure recovery, latency, and cost before scaling a workflow. * Add monitoring, useful logs, version control, automated tests, and clear documentation. Own failures after launch and fix their causes. * Protect customer and company data, separate brand and account contexts, and preserve human approval for consequential actions. * Choose the simplest approach that works, including ordinary code or deterministic automation when an LLM adds no value. ### **Help the company use AI well** * Work directly with teammates to understand their workflows, ship usable interfaces, and help them adopt what you build. * Create reusable skills and integrations rather than isolated prompts that only their author can operate. * Evaluate new models and tools through practical experiments, then explain what is worth adopting and why. * Measure outcomes such as time saved, adoption, output quality, and faster experiment cycles, not just the number of automations shipped. **We're Excited About Your** ---------------------------- * Experience shipping software that real users depend on, with ownership beyond the initial prototype. * Hands\-on LLM application development using Anthropic, OpenAI, or comparable APIs, including structured outputs, tool calling, retrieval, and multi\-step workflows. * Strong Python or TypeScript skills, sound software design, and comfort working with APIs, authentication, databases, and asynchronous jobs. * Practical understanding of RAG, context management, and MCP. You can explain the tradeoffs and show when a simpler approach is better. * Ability to build evaluations, diagnose unreliable behavior, and improve an AI system using evidence rather than prompt tweaking alone. * Working SQL proficiency and experience validating data against established reporting or warehouse models. * Product judgment and clear communication. You can turn an ambiguous request into a focused solution, explain technical tradeoffs, and work effectively with non\-technical partners. * Curiosity, initiative, and follow\-through. You experiment independently, learn quickly, and take responsibility for whether your work is useful. Experience with Claude Code, Codex, shared agent skills, or agent orchestration platforms such as OpenClaw is a plus. So is experience with ecommerce, consumer subscriptions, creative production, multimodal generation, or analytics tools such as PostHog and Metabase. We don't expect you to have used every tool in our stack. **How You'll Work** ------------------- You'll work on problems with visible business impact, from reducing manual reporting to making creative production and customer research more effective. You'll partner closely with the people doing the work, test with real inputs, and keep improving the system after it ships. We value people who can move quickly without confusing a convincing demo with a dependable product. Bring strong engineering fundamentals, good judgment about where AI helps, and a willingness to get into the details. **In Your Application** ----------------------- Tell us about an AI system you built that people actually use. What problem did it solve, what did you personally build, how did you evaluate it, and what failed along the way? Share a demo, repository, or architecture walkthrough where possible. Please don't include confidential information from another employer. **A Few of Our Perks and Benefits** ----------------------------------- * Competitive compensation and equity. * Health, dental, and vision plans. * HSA, FSA, and pre\-tax commuter benefits. * 401k to help you plan for the future. * Flexible PTO. * Unlimited Thesis nootropics. * A strong emphasis on personal development and promoting from within. * A dog\-friendly office in Flatiron, near Union Square and Madison Square Park. **Our Values** -------------- **Meet Your Potential:** Keep learning, seek honest feedback, and help others grow. **Own Outcomes:** Take responsibility for results, act with urgency, and follow through. **Lead with Science and Data:** Seek the truth through evidence and use it to make better decisions. **Create Exceptional Experiences:** Show up for teammates and customers with care, high standards, and a sense of belonging. **Pay Transparency** -------------------- Our salary ranges reflect competitive compensation for our size and industry and are one part of a total rewards package that includes benefits and equity. The base salary hiring range for this position is $160,000–$200,000\. Final compensation will be based on the candidate's location, skill level, and experience.

\- every client, every device, every month, no gaps * Own software stack compliance reporting \- confirm required tools are deployed and active on every device * Own patch compliance reporting \- track status, document remediation timelines, and follow through to resolution * Perform and document quarterly file restore tests and annual bare metal and cloud restore tests * Own all NOC process documentation and decision trees \- keep them current, accurate, and executable by any engineer * Partner with the Automation Specialist to transform alert triage from manual to intelligent * Handle advanced network troubleshooting and configuration \- VLANs, firewall rules, VPN, WatchGuard environments * Cross\-train engineers rotating through the NOC function **What You Bring** * 3\+ years of NOC, network administration, or systems monitoring experience in a managed services or multi\-client environment * Solid networking fundamentals \- VLANs, firewall administration, VPN, DNS/DHCP, routing * Experience owning compliance or reporting functions \- backup, patch, or security stack * Strong documentation discipline \- you build processes others can follow without asking questions * The ability to set direction for automation without necessarily writing the code yourself * Ability to work in person at our Ankeny, Iowa office **Nice to Have** * CompTIA Network\+ or Security\+ (within 90 days of hire) * Experience with Auvik, WatchGuard, Fortinet, or Meraki * Familiarity with backup platforms and restore testing procedures * Experience building or contributing to alert classification or automation workflows **Who Thrives Here** Our four core values are operational \- they describe the people who succeed at Tier 3, not the aspirations we hang on a wall. * See It Through \- You own the result, not just the task. The job is not done until the outcome is achieved. * Own the Mess \- When something goes wrong, even if it was not your fault, you step in and make it right. * Multiply the Team \- You share what you know. jobs.title: Engineering Manager, Robotics Hardware
jobs.description: **About Tutor** We believe robots are the biggest lever we have to making the physical world a better, more affordable place. But robots are a rounding error in our society: nearly nine out of ten American factories and warehouses don’t even have a single robot, and robots have yet to make their way into our homes or places of business. Tutor Intelligence is changing that. Tutor is a robotics research and deployment company, building generally capable robot hardware and artificial intelligence to enable robots to go where no robots have gone before. Sonny is a semi\-humanoid robot with frontier dexterity approaching the human form. Cassie does back\-breaking work, moving boxes, pallets, and bulk goods for businesses from family\-owned manufacturers to some of the largest brands in the world. Tutor robots are manufactured at scale and operate as a network, combining the whole fleet’s learned experience to train ever more capable robot artificial intelligence. Founded at MIT and headquartered in Watertown, MA, our team is full stack: we design and manufacture robot hardware, train our own models, work directly with the smallest and largest end\-customers, and maintain our fleet across the United States. We’re a team of researchers, engineers, technicians, operators, and sellers who love building things and solving hard problems. Our mission is grand: robots everywhere, for the common good, raising the standard of living across North America, and then the world. **Why Tutor?** Whether you’re designing robots, closing deals, running deployments, or creating the processes that help us scale, your work doesn’t sit on a shelf. It shows up on real production floors, making physical work safer and more affordable. Our team of 160\+ is driven by curiosity and a genuine love of building. Everyone here takes real ownership, learns fast, and holds a high bar while having each other’s backs. If you love hard problems and creating things that didn’t exist before, you’ll fit right in. **The Role** Tutor builds its own robots, and the hardware organization is about to get a lot bigger. Teams are growing, new teams are forming, and for the first time we are developing the next version of a robot while the current one ships. We are hiring engineering managers to run those teams. Each team owns a piece of a robot: a mechanism, an electronics subsystem, a research platform, or a new version of something already in the field. The manager owns the people, the schedule, and the design decisions, and works with manufacturing from the first concept so that what the team designs can be built. ### **What You'll Do** * Hire and run a team of hardware engineers, and grow them * Take a subsystem from concept through design, prototype, test, and release to manufacturing * Run your team's design reviews and make the calls that come out of them * Work with manufacturing, supply chain, quality, and field service on everything your team ships * Work with the software and research teams that depend on your hardware, and that your hardware depends on ### **What We're Looking For** * You were a strong engineer before you managed, and you have run a team of several engineers * You have designed and shipped electromechanical products * You have taken a design into manufacturing and lived with what happened next * You still read the drawings ### **Nice to Have** * Robots, or another product where mechanics, electronics, firmware, and software all have to work together * Products built in volume * Shipping one generation of a product while designing the next ### **Benefits** * **Fully employer\-covered health insurance**, so you’re protected without the premium. * **A managed 401(k)** to help you plan for the future. * **Generous time off:** unlimited PTO and all federal holidays off for full\-time salaried employees, and 16\+ days of accrued paid time off plus 1\.5x pay on federal holidays for hourly employees. * **Regular in\-office meals** and team social events throughout the year. **About Our Roles \& Titles** At Tutor, we believe great engineers and researchers are defined by what they build and the impact they have — not where they sit in an org chart or what title they have. Therefore, everyone in our R\&D org holds the title **Member of Technical Staff (MoTS)**. Our job postings use standard titles so you can find us, but if you join Tutor, you'll be a MoTS — with a level that is determined through the interview process. That also means we hire people, not slots. Work at Tutor evolves every quarter, and we set the expectation of flexibility from day one — it's common for people to start on one thing and shift to another based on where the team needs them most. A high technical bar across the board is what makes that flexibility possible: it's what allows people to contribute meaningfully whatever problem they take on. **Compensation** The base salary range for this role is $190,000 to $300,000, depending on experience. As Tutor grows, so will our benefits. We’re continuing to invest in ways to support our team at work and beyond. *Tutor Intelligence is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from all backgrounds.*

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Capacity & Efficiency Engineering (CEE) - Planning
jobs.description: **About the Role and Team** Engineering at Uber means building for real\-world impact under real\-world constraints. As a Senior Software Engineer on CEE, you will architect the systems that decide how much infrastructure Uber needs, where it runs, and what it costs. Our capacity planning platform turns business demand forecasts into resource plans, targets, and quotas across compute, storage, and data infrastructure, on\-prem and in the cloud. These plans drive Uber's infrastructure spend and capacity commitments, so engineering teams can ship without over\-provisioning and Finance can trust the numbers. The problems here are messy, the systems are massive, and plans get revised every forecast cycle. Demand is uncertain, cost attribution spans thousands of services and many source systems, and the numbers have to reconcile. You'll lead work that has no clear starting point, make smart decisions with imperfect information, and own outcomes end\-to\-end: from the first design doc to debugging a production pipeline when a planning deadline is on the line. We are looking for technical leaders who think in systems, hold a high bar for data correctness and reliability, and can bring Engineering, Finance, and infrastructure owners to a shared plan. If you're energized by challenge and motivated by real\-world impact, this is where you'll grow. **What You'll Do** * Design and build long\-lasting components of the capacity planning stack, including resource demand\-to\-supply forecasting models, plan\-of\-record pipelines, and the services that publish and manage capacity and spend plans, in ways that reduce complexity and make planning faster and more trustworthy for teams across Uber. * Solve messy, high\-impact problems at the intersection of forecast accuracy, data correctness, and cost, such as reconciling consumption, cost attribution, and Finance forecasts that come from different systems and don't agree, often without a clear starting point or obvious solution. * Foresee architectural problems and opportunities in the planning stack, such as source\-of\-truth migrations, scaling limits, or gaps between plans and enforcement, and work with leadership to address them before they affect a planning cycle or capacity commitment. * Lead multi\-team projects through every stage: inception, stakeholder alignment, implementation, rollout, and operations. Drive adoption of planning frameworks and tooling across infrastructure and product engineering organizations. * Collaborate with Product, Data Science, Finance, and infrastructure platform owners to translate ambiguous business requirements, such as budgets, efficiency targets, and growth scenarios, into production\-ready technical roadmaps. * Set the bar for operational excellence: own on\-call and incident response for planning pipelines and services, drive root\-cause fixes, and build the monitoring and data\-quality checks that keep plans correct and on time around forecast deadlines. * Mentor and guide other engineers through design reviews, code reviews, and project leadership, role\-modeling coding and design best practices and raising the bar across CEE. **Basic Qualifications** * 6\+ years of professional experience in backend software engineering, data engineering, or a related technical role. * Expertise in writing high\-quality code in one or more languages (e.g., Go, Java, or Python) to solve strategically important problems that span multiple teams or organizations. * Advanced proficiency in SQL, data modeling, and data warehousing, with a demonstrated ability to identify and reconcile gaps between data sources and system architectures. * Experience leading cross\-team engineering projects through all lifecycle stages: inception, stakeholder engagement, implementation, and operations. * Track record of owning production reliability, including leading incident response, running on\-call rotations, and driving root\-cause fixes. * Demonstrated ability to make sound engineering and business trade\-offs, considering long\-term implications for Uber. * Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with forecasting, optimization, or statistical modeling, and with turning models into reliable production systems that drive financial decisions. * Domain experience in capacity planning, resource quotas or scheduling, cloud cost management, or cost showback or chargeback systems. * Expertise with Big Data frameworks (e.g., Spark, Hive, Flink) and workflow orchestration used to automate complex data pipelines across multiple product areas. * Experience building scalable distributed systems or data platforms that operate across a large, heterogeneous infrastructure fleet, on\-prem and multi\-cloud. * Proven ability to get alignment and buy\-in for large\-scale technical and process changes across Engineering, Finance, and leadership. * Experience representing your team to the broader engineering organization, with a track record of translating complex technical concepts for executives and non\-technical stakeholders. For San Francisco, CA\-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $202,000 per year \- USD $224,000 per year. For Seattle, WA\-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $202,000 per year \- USD $224,000 per year. For Sunnyvale, CA\-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $202,000 per year \- USD $224,000 per year. For all US locations, you will be eligible to participate in Uber's bonus program, and may be offered an equity award \& other types of comp. All full\-time employees are eligible to participate in a 401(k) plan. You will also be eligible for various benefits. **Ready to Ride?** This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook — it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves — we'd love to hear from you. You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits. Offices remain key to collaboration and Uber's culture. Unless approved for full remote work, employees must spend at least 50% of their time in\-office. Some roles, like those at greenlight hubs, require full\-time in\-office presence. Ask your Recruiter for details about this role's requirements. Uber is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing this form.

jobs.title: Process Engineer I, Data and Knowledge Management
jobs.description: ### **Join our Mission to Protect Humankind!** Vaxcyte is a clinical\-stage vaccine innovation company engineering high\-fidelity vaccines to protect humankind from the consequences of bacterial diseases, which have serious and costly health consequences when left unchecked. Working to eradicate or treat bacterial infections such as invasive pneumococcal disease, Group A Strep, and Shigella is just the beginning. Our path to success is clear and well\-defined, and Vaxcyte is set up to go the distance. **WHAT** we do is every bit as important as **HOW** we do it! Our work together is guided by four enduring core values: * RETHINK CONVENTION: We bring creative and intellectual diversity to every facet of the work we do in order to innovate and re\-innovate the way vaccines are delivered. * AIM HIGH: We embody our collectively audacious goal to courageously make the most complex biologics ever attempted to protect humankind. * LEAD WITH HEART: Everyone leads at Vaxcyte with a kindness\-first, inclusive approach to collaboration and vigorous debate that advances our business objectives. * MODEL EXCELLENCE: The magnitude of our challenge requires our shared commitment to demonstrating integrity, accountability, equality and clarity across communications and decision making. ### **Summary:** As we grow, we are seeking a strategic and collaborative Process Engineer I, Data and Knowledge Management to ensure the integrity, accessibility, and effective use of data and knowledge assets across the organization. This role will execute component\-level analysis, utilizing data and knowledge resources critical to our process development, regulatory, and operational activities. The Process Engineer I, Data and Knowledge Management is instrumental in ensuring scientific data integrity, regulatory readiness, and the preservation of institutional knowledge in a dynamic, fast\-paced clinical environment. ### **Essential Functions:** **Engineering Analytics \& Process Insights:** * Assess process trends and discrepancies using engineering knowledge, and evaluate the technical rationale and potential impact of proposed process improvements * Apply chemical and biochemical engineering principles to evaluate relationships between process parameters, unit operation performance, and product quality attributes * Partner with data science team to drive data visualization, reporting, and insights. * Support the use of AI/ML and automation for improved data analysis and knowledge extraction. **Manufacturing Process Data Management \& Governance:** * Acquire, integrate, and technically evaluate manufacturing process data from internal teams and contract manufacturing sites to support process monitoring, continuous improvement, and CMC regulatory submissions. * Develop data management and verification workflows that preserve the accuracy, integrity, and traceability of manufacturing process data. * Lead and own data verification for all commercial regulatory submissions. **Process Knowledge Management:** * Develop structured systems and workflows to capture and retain organizational knowledge, including protocols, study results, lessons learned, and decision rationales. * Develop tools and processes that enable technical teams to access, share, and apply process knowledge to support manufacturing and process improvement. * Champion a knowledge\-sharing culture across technical, scientific and operational functions. **Collaboration \& Technical Leadership:** * Partner with regulatory, quality, R\&D, IT and contract manufacturing teams to understand technical needs and develop appropriate solutions. **Compliance \& Risk Management:** * Ensure compliance with data protection and clinical trial regulations, including GDPR, HIPAA, and 21 CFR Part 11\. * Identify and mitigate risks related to data security, access, and retention. ### **Requirements:** Bachelor’s degree in Chemical Engineering, Bioprocess Engineering, or a related engineering discipline is required. 8\+ years of relevant experience in biopharmaceutical process engineering, Manufacturing Science and Technology (MSAT), process development, manufacturing technical support, or related engineering work, including at least 3 years in the life sciences or biotechnology industry. Other combinations of education and/or experience may be considered. * Experience interpreting manufacturing process data and applying engineering and statistical methods to evaluate process performance. * Proven experience leading enterprise data governance and knowledge sharing initiatives in a highly regulated environment. * Strong technical communication, project management, and cross\-functional collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with engineering, scientific, and manufacturing teams. * Experience with tools like SharePoint, Veeva Vault, Confluence, Tableau, and SQL is highly desirable. **Preferred:** * Experience supporting clinical trials and regulatory submissions (e.g., IND, BLA). * Background in immunology, vaccines, or infectious disease R\&D. * Experience in scaling systems and processes in a high\-growth, early\- to mid\-stage. **Reports to:** Senior Director, Process Validation, Global MSAT **Location:** United States **Work Arrangement (may be adjusted based on business needs, job responsibilities, or changes to company policy):** Remote **Compensation:** The compensation package will be competitive and includes comprehensive benefits and an equity component. **Salary Range:** $121,000 \- $142,000 **Relocation:** This role is not eligible for relocation assistance.**Equal Opportunity** *We are an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or veteran status.* **Recruitment Fraud Notice** *Please be aware of fraud or scams from individuals, organizations and/or internet sites claiming to represent Vaxcyte in recruitment activities. All legitimate communication from Vaxcyte will come from an official @vaxcyte.com email address. Qualified and interested candidates should apply to current openings at* *vaxcyte.com/careers**.*

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer- Product Reliability Engineering
jobs.description: **About Us** Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid. At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world. Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you. **Job Description** Every time someone taps, swipes, or clicks to pay\- Visa infrastructure makes it happen in milliseconds, across 200\+ countries. As a Software Development Engineer on the Product Reliability Engineering (PRE) team, you won’t just watch those systems run\- you’ll be one of the engineers building, automating, and evolving them. PRE is not a traditional ops team. We are a software engineering organization that treats infrastructure as code, reliability as a product, and automation as a strategic advantage. You’ll write Python, build agentic AI tools, manage data platforms, and contribute to the distributed systems that process billions of real\-time transactions. From day one, you are an engineer\- and from day one, your work matters. If you are endlessly curious about how large\-scale systems stay resilient, obsess over elegant automation, and want to launch your career at the intersection of AI, infrastructure, and global financial technology — this role was built for you. **Build Automation That Scales** * Design and ship end\-to\-end automation for deployment pipelines, infrastructure provisioning, and release orchestration — code that runs millions of times so engineers never have to repeat themselves. * Write clean, production\-grade Python (and Go or Bash where it counts) to eliminate toil, reduce manual intervention, and make systems self\-managing. * Develop modular frameworks for release scheduling, validation, rollback, and reporting that integrate across the full software delivery lifecycle. **Manage \& Evolve Data Platforms** * Support the build, deployment, and operations of relational database systems, contributing to schema design, architecture decisions, and solution engineering for critical payment data infrastructure. * Gain exposure to real\-time event streaming architectures that support payment processing at scale * Perform database health operations including patching, upgrades, backups, and recovery to maintain the availability and integrity of tier\-1 production databases. * Optimize query performance through index tuning, execution plan analysis, and replication monitoring — targeting metrics like query execution time, CPU usage, and replication latency. * Automate database tasks and configuration management using tools like Ansible and Liquibase, and contribute to CI/CD pipelines that govern schema changes through TEST and PROD environments safely. * Build predictive and reactive monitoring dashboards for database anomalies, surfacing health signals before they become incidents. **Ship Agentic AI \& ML\-Powered Tools** * Build GenAI\-powered engineering assistants that automate deployment orchestration, release governance, and environment lifecycle management. * Integrate LLMs into observability, incident response, and developer support workflows, transforming reactive operations into proactive, AI\-driven intelligence. * Contribute to prompt engineering, model fine\-tuning, and agentic automation initiatives that position PRE as one of the most AI\-forward reliability organizations in financial technology. **Own Observability \& Platform Health** * Build dashboards, alerts, and metrics using Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk, or ELK that give engineers real\-time clarity on complex, globally distributed systems. * Analyze system performance and availability data and turn insights into infrastructure improvements that prevent incidents before they occur. * Contribute to self\-healing and auto\-scaling capabilities that keep critical payment infrastructure resilient without human intervention. **Engineer for Reliability \& Security** * Ensure infrastructure and data platforms meet security and compliance standards across cloud\-native deployments supporting global financial services at scale. * Support zero\-downtime deployment strategies and high\-availability architectures that Visa’s partners and billions of cardholders depend on around the clock. * Participate in threat modeling, vulnerability remediation, and audit readiness activities as part of a team that treats security as a first\-class engineering concern. **Collaborate, Learn \& Grow Fast** * Embed within Agile squads, working alongside senior engineers, product managers, and global PRE peers across sprint planning, reviews, and release discussions. * Document runbooks, SOPs, and engineering guides that make the team smarter, faster, and more autonomous over time. * Participate in on\-call rotations (with robust support structures and mentorship) to build the incident response instincts that distinguish great reliability engineers. Visa will accept applications for this role until at least November 6th, 2026\. **Visa is not offering relocation assistance for this role.** **Visa is not supporting immigration support for this role.** **Qualifications** **Basic Qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree, OR 3\+ years of relevant work experience **Preferred Qualifications:** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field (2023–2025 graduates preferred; December 2025 graduates welcome). * Solid foundations in data structures, algorithms, and systems design \-you can reason about complexity, tradeoffs, and failure modes. * Proficiency in Python and comfort writing scripts or tools in at least one additional language (Go, Java, or Bash). * Foundational understanding of relational databases (RDBMS): SQL, data modeling, query optimization, and database connectivity troubleshooting. * Familiarity with Linux/Unix environments and meaningful command\-line fluency. * Exposure to cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and a conceptual understanding of containerization (Docker, Kubernetes). * Understanding of CI/CD principles and how modern software delivery pipelines are structured and maintained. * Genuine curiosity about GenAI platforms and agentic systems (OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, LangChain, or similar)\- hands\-on exposure is a plus, intellectual interest is a must. **Bonus Points:** * Hands\-on experience with infrastructure\-as\-code tools: Terraform, Ansible, or Pulumi \-even from coursework, a capstone, or an internship. * Experience with database CI/CD tooling, particularly Liquibase for schema change management across environments. * Experience with observability tooling: Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk, ELK, or Datadog. * Database administration exposure: backup/recovery procedures, performance tuning, index management, or replication monitoring. * Familiarity with Git workflows and modern DevOps toolchains (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, ArgoCD). * Academic or project experience with ML frameworks: scikit\-learn, PyTorch, or LangChain / LangGraph. * Understanding of networking fundamentals: DNS, load balancing, service mesh, or TCP/IP. * A GitHub profile, personal project, hackathon entry, or open\-source contribution that shows us how you think and build. Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager. **Information for US Applicants** Visa has a comprehensive benefits package for which this position may be eligible that includes Medical, Dental, Vision, 401(k), FSA/HSA, Life Insurance, Paid Time Off, and Wellness Program.**Work Hours** Varies upon the needs of the department. **Travel Requirements** This position requires travel 5\-10% of the time. **Mental/Physical Requirements** This position will be performed in an office setting. The position will require the incumbent to sit and stand at a desk, communicate in person and by telephone, frequently operate standard office equipment, such as telephones and computers. **Visa is an EEO Employer** Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protect veteran status. jobs.title: DSHS FTAA IT Application Developer - Journey
jobs.description: **Description** --------------- Financial systems must keep working, even as the technology behind them changes. As an IT Application Developer with the Department of Social and Health Services (DSHS), you'll update financial applications to support Washington's One Washington initiative and the transition to Workday. These systems support accounting, budgeting, and financial operations that help DSHS serve Washington residents. You won't be expected to learn these systems alone. You'll work alongside senior developers to understand requirements, design solutions, write code, and test changes. Your week will include Agile development cycles, troubleshooting, peer reviews, and collaboration with business and technical teams. **We encourage you to apply if** you enjoy solving technical problems, can explain your design decisions, and welcome feedback. You understand that reliable software depends on both sound code and a clear understanding of business needs. **Your first 90 days** are about learning the applications, development tools, and business processes. You'll review existing code, work with senior developers, and begin contributing changes. Within your first year, success means you can develop, test, and implement changes that support the One Washington transition. The opportunity comes with a defined timeline. There are two one\-year project positions, with possible extensions dependent on additional funding. You'll work Monday through Friday, 8 a.m. to 5 p.m., with at least two days each week at Office Building 2 during your first three months. No additional travel is expected. The Olympia area offers access to South Puget Sound, parks, and trails, although wet winters and commuting conditions are worth considering. Still reading? Here's what you'll do. **Some of What You'll Do** * Develop and maintain financial applications and data interfaces. * Analyze requirements and design technical solutions. * Write, test, debug, and review application code. * Update systems and integrations for One Washington and Workday. * Troubleshoot production issues and application failures. * Participate in Agile development cycles and peer reviews. * Collaborate with senior developers and business teams. * Document system changes, designs, and test procedures. * Follow development, security, and quality standards. **Who Should Apply** Meet one of these pathways: * Seven years of recent professional software development and maintenance experience; or * An associate degree in computer science or a closely related field and five years of professional software development and maintenance experience; or * A bachelor's degree or higher in computer science or a closely related field and three years of professional software development and maintenance experience. Qualifying experience includes analyzing, designing, implementing, programming, or maintaining software applications. You must also have experience or training in some of these technologies: Java, C\#, .NET, Microsoft SQL Server, Transact\-SQL, HTML, CSS, or JavaScript. **Preferred knowledge, skills, and abilities** * Experience with C\#, .NET, JavaScript, SQL Server, or Transact\-SQL. * Knowledge of SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS) or Integration Services (SSIS). * Experience with TFS, Azure DevOps, or Agile/Scrum. * Experience with application integration and production troubleshooting. * Ability to explain technical decisions and collaborate during reviews. **How to Apply** Submit: * Your resume. * Your cover letter. * Three professional references. Include details about the applications you've developed, technologies used, and your contributions. **Questions?** Email recruiter Kris George at kris.george@dshs.wa.gov and reference job number 08822\. The Department of Social and Health Services’ (DSHS) vision that people find human services to shape their own lives requires that we come together with a sense of belonging, common purpose, shared values, and meaningful work. It is crucial to our agency’s vision that you bring a fairness, access, and social justice commitment to your work with DSHS. We strive to support all Washingtonians, including Black, Indigenous, and People of Color, people with physical, behavioral health, and intellectual disabilities, elders, LGBTQIA\+ individuals, immigrants and refugees, and families building financial security. **Supplemental Information** ---------------------------- Prior to a new hire, a background check including criminal record history may be conducted. Information from the background check will not necessarily preclude employment but will be considered in determining the applicant’s suitability and competence to perform in the job. This announcement may be used to fill multiple vacancies. Employees driving on state business must have a valid driver's license. Employees driving a privately owned vehicle on state business must have liability insurance on the privately owned vehicle. Washington State Department of So s the flexibility to choose between multiple investment options. **Social Security** All state employees are covered by the federal Social Security and Medicare systems. The state and the employee pay an equal amount into the system. **Public Service Loan Forgiveness** If you are employed by a government or not\-for\-profit organization, and meet the qualifying criteria, you may be eligible to receive student loan forgiveness under the Public Service Loan Forgiveness Program. **Holidays** Full\-time and part\-time employees are entitled to paid holidays and one paid personal holiday per calendar year. **Note:** Employees who are members of certain Unions may be entitled to additional personal leave day(s), please refer to position specific Collective Bargaining Agreements for more information*.* Full\-time employees who work full monthly schedules qualify for holiday compensation if they are employed before the holiday and are in pay status for at least 80 nonovertime hours during the month of the holiday; or for the entire work shift preceding the holiday. Part\-time employees who are in pay status during the month of the holiday qualify for the holiday on a pro\-rata basis. Compensation for holidays (including personal holiday) will be proportionate to the number of hours in pay status in the month to that required for full\-time employment, excluding all holiday hours. Pay status includes hours worked and time on paid leave. **Sick Leave** Full\-time employees earn eight hours of sick leave per month. Overtime eligible employees who are in pay status for less than 80 hours per month, earn a monthly proportionate to the number of hours in pay status, in the month to that required for full\-time employment. Overtime exempt employees who are in pay status for less than 80 hours per month do not earn a monthly accrual of sick leave. Sick leave accruals for part\-time employees will be proportionate to the number of hours in pay status, in the month to that required for full\-time employment. Pay status includes hours worked, time on paid leave and paid holiday. **Vacation (Annual Leave)** Full\-time employees accrue vacation leave at the rates specified in WAC 357\-31\-165(1\) or the applicable collective bargaining agreement (CBA). Full\-time employees who are in pay status for less than 80 nonovertime hours in a month do not earn a monthly accrual of vacation leave. Part\-time employees accrue vacation leave hours in accordance with WAC 357\-31\-165(1\) or the applicable collective bargaining agreement (CBA) on a pro rata basis. Vacation leave accrual will be proportionate to the number of hours in pay status, in the month to that required for full\-time employment. Pay status includes hours worked, time on paid leave and paid holiday. As provided in WAC 357\-58\-175, an employer may authorize a lump\-sum accrual of vacation leave or accelerate the vacation leave accrual rate to support the recruitment and/or retention of a candidate or employee for a Washington Management Service position. Vacation leave accrual rates may only be accelerated using the rates established WAC 357\-31\-165\. **Note:** Most agencies follow the civil service rules covering leave and holidays for **exempt** employees even though there is no requirement for them to do so. However, agencies are required to adhere to the applicable RCWs pertaining holidays and leave. **Military Leave** Washington State supports members of the armed forces with 21 days paid military leave per year. **Bereavement Leave** Most employees whose family member or household member dies, or for loss of pregnancy, are entitled to five (5\) days of paid bereavement leave. In addition, the employer may approve other available leave types for the purpose of bereavement leave. **Additional Leave** Leave Sharing Parental Leave Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA) Leave Without Pay Please visit the State HR Website for more detailed information regarding benefits. jobs.title: Enterprise Solutions Engineer
jobs.description: **The Enterprise** **Solutions** **Engineer is a senior individual contributor responsible for translating enterprise architecture direction into working technical capabilities, reusable engineering patterns, and time\-boxed proofs of concept. The position partners across Enterprise Architecture, IT Delivery, Cloud Operations, Data and Enterprise Platforms, Information Security, and business\-aligned technology teams to improve how WPCU designs, builds, tests, deploys, integrates, and operates technology solutions.** **This position requires broad technical fluency, learning agility, and strong engineering judgment; it does not require deep specialization in every platform, tool, or technology domain referenced in this description. The role works closely with Enterprise Architects to test architectural direction through practical implementation, identify constraints or delivery friction, and turn approved patterns into reusable assets that delivery teams can adopt.** **The role does not serve as the long\-term product owner, application development team, or operator of infrastructure and technology platforms. It proves feasibility, develops reusable enablement assets, accelerates difficult technical work, and transfers production ownership to the accountable delivery or operations team.** 1\) Enterprise Engineering Capabilities (30%) a) Design, build, and evolve reusable engineering capabilities that improve software delivery, with an initial emphasis on CI/CD, automated testing, deployment automation, release evidence, secure delivery controls, and environment promotion. b) Create shared templates, scripts, reference implementations, documentation, and adoption guidance that can be used across multiple technology delivery domains. c) Partner with platform owners so enterprise patterns use supported WPCU platforms without assuming ongoing operational ownership of those platforms. d) Measure adoption and outcomes, identify friction, and improve the engineering capabilities based on delivery\-team feedback. 2\) Technical Prototyping and Proofs of Concept (25%) a) Rapidly assess business and technology opportunities and build time\-boxed proofs of concept to determine feasibility, constraints, security considerations, integration requirements, and likely production approach. b) Develop working code, integrations, deployment patterns, or technical demonstrations for use cases involving APIs, workflow automation, vendor platforms, cloud services, data movement, and emerging technologies. c) Document findings, decisions, assumptions, risks, costs, and recommended next steps in a form that enables leadership and delivery teams to make informed decisions. d) Establish explicit entry, exit, and handoff criteria so proofs of concept do not become unsupported production solutions. 3\) Architecture Enablement and Reference Implementation (20%) a) Partner with Enterprise Architects to validate target\-state patterns through working implementations rather than documentation alone. b) Create reference implementations for integration, API\-centered design, application decomposition, telemetry, resiliency, security, and other enterprise standards. c) Provide hands\-on technical guidance to delivery teams adopting approved patterns and help resolve difficult implementation issues. d) Identify where architecture standards are impractical, incomplete, or creating unnecessary delivery friction and recommend improvements. 4\) Application Modernization and Delivery Acceleration (15%) a) Assess legacy and vendor\-constrained deployment patterns and identify opportunities for full or partial automation, repeatability, auditability, and risk reduction. b) Help teams establish practical modernization approaches, including API enablement, modular decomposition, automated deployment, database change automation, and improved testability. c) Facilitate short technical spikes that reduce uncertainty before major investments or implementation commitments are made. d) Support knowledge transfer, pairing, and mentoring so delivery teams can independently sustain the resulting approach. 5\) Governance, Risk, and Operational Readiness (10%) a) Embed security, risk, SSDLC, change control, and audit\-evidence requirements into reusable engineering patterns wherever practical. b) Ensure experimental work uses appropriate controls, approved environments, representative non\-production data, and clearly documented limitations. c) Coordinate with accountable teams to define production support, monitoring, service ownership, recovery, and lifecycle responsibilities before handoff. d) Ensure proper policies, procedures, risk mitigation activities and operating controls are followed. Report gaps in policies, procedures, operating controls and impacts to member experience to leadership to ensure that member impact and risk is mitigated. Required Skills 1\) Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field is preferred. Candidates with an equivalent combination of formal training and relevant experience may also be considered. 2\) Typically requires 7 or more years of progressive experience in software engineering, systems integration, DevOps, platform engineering, cloud engineering, or a closely related technical field. 3\) Demonstrated ability to rapidly learn unfamiliar technologies and create working proofs of concept. 4\) Hands\-on experience with source control, build/release practices, deployment automation, or CI/CD platforms. 5\) Proficiency in at least one programming or scripting language, with the ability to read and work across multiple technology stacks. 6\) Ability to distinguish prototypes from production solutions and to design appropriate handoff, support, documentation, security, and lifecycle requirements. 7\) Strong technical writing and communication skills, including the ability to explain complex engineering tradeoffs to architects, delivery teams, operations teams, vendors, and leadership. 8\) Valid driver’s license and ability to operate a motor vehicle. 9\) Ability to pass background checks required for access to WPCU facilities or supported third\-party locations, where applicable. **Preferred qualifications** 10\) Experience with Azure DevOps or comparable CI/CD platforms, including build automation, artifact management, approvals, testing, security scanning, and deployment orchestration. 11\) Experience designing or consuming REST APIs, webhooks, event\-based integrations, authentication mechanisms, or secure system\-to\-system integrations. 12\) Working knowledge of SQL databases and database delivery practices. 13\) Experience with automated testing, secure software development practices, secrets management, configuration management, or infrastructure/configuration as code. 14\) Working knowledge of observability and reliability concepts, including logs, metrics, traces, health checks, alerting, and operational readiness. 15\) Experience in a regulated industry or with auditable technology controls.
